episodesList.title: Annalakshmi's Recipe for Revenge
episodesList.summary: Santhi tries to widen the rift between Annalakshmi and Nandini. Later, Annalakshmi assigns a tough task to Nandini and Shwetha!

episodesList.title: Chinnathambi Needs a Job
episodesList.summary: Chinnathambi decides to look for a job. Prabha offers money to Chinnathambi as soon as she learns about the challenge. Will he accept it?

episodesList.title: Nandini Wants a TV Set
episodesList.summary: Nandini demands a TV from Chinnathambi. Can he get her one?

episodesList.title: Nandini Hits Back
episodesList.summary: Shwetha feels bad about Chinnathambi doing labour work and confronts Nandini when Nandini gives her a harsh reply.

episodesList.title: Chinnathambi's Great Deed
episodesList.summary: Annalakshmi gets annoyed when Nandini orders Malar to clean her room. Chinnathambi gives some money to Amal for his mother's treatment.

episodesList.title: Nandini Treats Chinnathambi
episodesList.summary: Annalakshmi praises Chinnathambi for helping Amal. Nandini treats Chinnathambi when she sees a wound on his hand.

episodesList.title: The Lord Hears Chinnathambi
episodesList.summary: Chinnathambi's prayer to God for guidance to earn large amount of money is answered!

episodesList.title: Chinnathambi, Nandini Get Intimate
episodesList.summary: Nandini is impressed to see Chinnathambi's physique while he works out. Later at night, Chinnathambi gets intimate with Nandini and kisses her.

episodesList.title: Chinnathambi, Kaali Face-Off
episodesList.summary: Kaali warns Chinnathambi to not participate in the wrestling competition and save his life. Chinnathambi takes up an endurance test before getting trained. Will he pass?

episodesList.title: Chinnathambi Fails the Test
episodesList.summary: The coach condemns Chinnathambi as he fails the endurance test. Will Chinnathambi give up on his dreams?

episodesList.title: Kaali, Somu Join Hands
episodesList.summary: Kaali joins hands with Somu to avenge Chinnathambi as the wrestling competition starts. Elsewhere, Nandini is surprised to see Annalakshmi's concern for her.

episodesList.title: Chinnathambi Gets Stronger
episodesList.summary: Annalakshmi asks Shwetha to keep an eye on Nandini. Chinnathambi bonds with his father as he encourages him to win the competition.

episodesList.title: Chinnathambi Gets Beaten
episodesList.summary: Annalakshmi scolds Nandini for taking out her mangalsutra. Chinnathambi gets badly beaten up by his opponent in the wrestling bout.

episodesList.title: Chinnathambi Wins the Match
episodesList.summary: Chinnathambi shocks Kaali by defeating his opponent despite his injuries and is keen on participating in the next match, against the doctors advise.

episodesList.title: Chinnathambi's Shocking Decision
episodesList.summary: Shwetha is shocked to learn that Chinnathambi is to participate in the wrestling competition. Later, Chinnathambi makes a shocking announcement after Nandini teases him.

episodesList.title: Last Day for Chinnathambi
episodesList.summary: Nandini tells everyone that Chinnathambi will fail if he doesn't get the TV by the end of day. Later, Chinnathambi and friends are attacked by some goons.

episodesList.title: Chinnathambi Beaten to a Pulp!
episodesList.summary: Chinnathambi gets tied to a tree and beaten up by goons. Kaali takes advantage of the same and calls Chinnathambi a coward in front of everyone.

episodesList.title: Kaali Overpowers Chinnathambi
episodesList.summary: Annalakshmi and the others are thrilled as Chinnathambi makes a dramatic entry. Kaali thrashes Chinnathambi and pins him to the ground!

episodesList.title: Chinnathambi's Victory
episodesList.summary: Chinnathambi defeats Kaali and hands over the prize money to Nandini. A regretful Nandini decides to leave the village.

episodesList.title: Prabha is Overjoyed
episodesList.summary: Prabha is ecstatic on learning about Chinnathambi's victory. However, Gowtham gets furious when Varsha tells him about the same!

episodesList.title: Nandini's Unforgivable Mistake
episodesList.summary: Despite Nandini's apologies, Annalakshmi refuses to forgive her. Nandini regrets her mistakes while Annalakshmi is adamant to throw her out of the house.

episodesList.title: Nandini Tends to Chinnathambi
episodesList.summary: Nandini sacrifices her sleep in order to take care of Chinnathambi. Annalakshmi seeks Revathi's help and calls her home.

episodesList.title: Nandini Enrages Annalakshmi
episodesList.summary: Annalakshmi becomes furious as Nandini holds Chinnathambi when he slips. She almost gets set to hit Nandini when she refuses to take her hands off him, but Prabha intervenes!

episodesList.title: Nandini Gets a Warning
episodesList.summary: Prabha apologises to Annalakshmi on Nandini's behalf. Chinnathambi's Vaithiyar warns Nandini to take good care of Chinnathambi as he is in a critical condition.

episodesList.title: Nandini Visits a Temple
episodesList.summary: Nandini visits a temple and performs a tough ritual after having a nightmare. Annalakshmi witnesses Nandini perform the ritual.

episodesList.title: Police at Chinnathambi's House
episodesList.summary: Santhi, Samudram and Shwetha are shocked to see Nandini feeding Chinnathambi. Later, the police arrive to arrest Rathanaswami and Chinnathambi. Why?

episodesList.title: Nandini Apologises to Chinnathambi
episodesList.summary: Rathanaswami feels dejected as Rajasekhar ignores his words. Nandini apologises to Chinnathambi on behalf of her father

episodesList.title: Annalakshmi Ousts Shwetha
episodesList.summary: Santhi feels content as she reveals the entire incident to Annalakshmi. Annalakshmi berates Shwetha and asks her to get out of the house.

episodesList.title: Nandini Takes Charge
episodesList.summary: Nandini insists Shwetha to return home and informs Prabha about the same. Prabha is impressed hearing Nandini's wise decision.

episodesList.title: Chinnathambi's Confession
episodesList.summary: Shwetha decides to take leave and asks Chinnathambi to make a promise. Chinnathambi confesses the truth before Annalakshmi and defends Nandini. W

episodesList.title: Shwetha Bids Goodbye
episodesList.summary: Shwetha takes leave from Chinnathambi's house. Malar consoles Nandini and they bond with each other.

episodesList.title: Chinnathambi Feels Embarrassed
episodesList.summary: Chinnathambi feels shy as Nandini helps him wear his dhoti. Later, Samudram and Santhi are on cloud nine as they visit Nandini's house.

episodesList.title: Trouble Follows Nandini
episodesList.summary: Nandini is bowled over by Chinnathambi's generosity. Later, Annalakshmi becomes furious as Nandini creates yet another mess at home.

episodesList.title: Nandini Makes a Promise
episodesList.summary: Nandini gets hurt as Annalakshmi accuses her of creating problems in Chinnathambi's life. Later, Nandini makes a promise to Chinnathambi for winning the challenge.

episodesList.title: Nandini Prepares the Medicine
episodesList.summary: Nandini takes up the strenuous task of preparing Chinnathambi's medicine. Later, they share some lovely moments.

episodesList.title: Santhi Annoys Annalakshmi
episodesList.summary: Santhi returns home and annoys Annalakshmi by talking about Nandini's luxurious house. Further, she shocks Annalakshmi by bringing home a new television set.

episodesList.title: Santhi's Wicked Plot
episodesList.summary: Santhi wants to create friction between Nandini and Annalakshmi and suggests Nandini to watch TV all day. Will her plan work?

episodesList.title: Annalakshmi Feels Insecure
episodesList.summary: Annalakshmi gets agitated by Nandini and Chinnathambi's closeness. Santhi uses this opportunity and tells Annalakshmi that Nandini will separate her and Chinnathambi.

episodesList.title: Chinnathambi's Gift for Nandini
episodesList.summary: Maragada's visit aggravates Annalakshmi's insecurity. Later, Chinnathambi gets enchanted with Nandini's beauty when she wears a saree he gifted her.

episodesList.title: Annalakshmi's Bizzare Demand
episodesList.summary: After having a nightmare about Nandini and Chinnathambi, Annalakshmi forbids them from sleeping together. Later, Nandini is scared to sleep alone.

episodesList.title: Annalakshmi Lashes Out at Nandini
episodesList.summary: Annalakshmi berates Nandini for watching TV all day. Later, Prabha feels ecstatic as she receives a surprise gift.

episodesList.title: Gowtham Surprises Chinnathambi
episodesList.summary: Gowtham visits Chinnathambi and apologises to him for the past events. Later, he organises a felicitation program for Chinnathambi.

episodesList.title: Chinnathambi Gets Teased
episodesList.summary: Annalakshmi and Santhi are shocked to witness Nandini sleeping next to Chinnathambi. Later, Chinnathambi's friends tease him.

episodesList.title: Rathanaswami Loses His Temper
episodesList.summary: Shwetha asks Nandini to stop following Annalakshmi's instructions. Later, Rathanaswami raises his voice against Annalakshmi!

episodesList.title: It's Nandini's Birthday
episodesList.summary: Shwetha and Prabha rejoice learning about Nandini's marital life. Later, Nandini reminisces her past on the occasion of her birthday, while Chinnathambi plans a surprise.

episodesList.title: Chinnathambi Has a Surprise
episodesList.summary: Nandini gets emotional as Rajasekhar wishes her on her birthday. Later, she is all curious as Chinnathambi asks her out.

episodesList.title: Chinnathambi Upsets Nandini
episodesList.summary: Chinnathambi gifts Nandini a ring but her happiness is short-lived when she learns about Gowtham's involvement in the surprise.

episodesList.title: Chinnathambi Surprises Nandini
episodesList.summary: Chinnathambi surprises Nandini by celebrating her birthday amongst children. Meanwhile, trouble awaits him as Gowtham and Kaali team up.

episodesList.title: Nandini's Sweet Thank You
episodesList.summary: As a part of Nandini's treat for her birthday, she cooks pulao for Chinnathambi and his family. Later, Annalakshmi gets furious with Nandini. Why?

episodesList.title: A Surprise for Nandini
episodesList.summary: Annalakshmi lashes out at Nandini for making a mess while cooking. However, Chinnathambi lightens up the latter's mood with a surprise for her.

episodesList.title: Nandini's Advice to Chinnathambi
episodesList.summary: Nandini's happiness reaches its peak when Chinnathambi surprises her by painting the house with her favourite colour. Later, she advises him to make a living of his own.

episodesList.title: Chinnathambi Works Hard
episodesList.summary: Chinnathambi works hard and buys clothes for Annalakshmi and Nandini with his first salary. However, Annalakshmi refuses to accept his gift. Why?

episodesList.title: Annalakshmi's Sorrow
episodesList.summary: Annalakshmi finally accepts the gift but her happiness is short-lived when Santhi poisons her mind against Nandini. Later, Nandini and Chinnathambi decide to go out.

episodesList.title: Chinnathambi, Nandini in Trouble?
episodesList.summary: Chinnathambi and Nandini take part in a competition for newly wedded couples. Meanwhile, Shanthi spots them playing on the TV.

episodesList.title: Nandini Supports Chinnathambi
episodesList.summary: Nandini stands by Chinnathambi when he gets humiliated for not knowing English. Later, when Nandini goes missing, he gets emotional and searches for her.

episodesList.title: Nandini Falls Sick
episodesList.summary: Nandini and Chinnathambi meet with a minor accident and return home. Later, he takes care of Nandini when she falls sick.

episodesList.title: Gautham's Offer to Chinnathambi
episodesList.summary: Annalakshmi commands Nandini to wash Chinnathambi's clothes. Meanwhile, Gautham invites Chinnathambi for the felicitation programme and offers him a job.

episodesList.title: Gautham Meets Nandini
episodesList.summary: Nandini becomes uncomfortable when Gautham arrives at Chinnathambi's house to invite his family to the felicitation programme.

episodesList.title: Nandini's Caring Gesture
episodesList.summary: Chinnathambi gets awestruck when Nandini visits his workplace for lunch. Later, Malar's question to Nandini makes her blush. What is it?

episodesList.title: Nandini Is in Love
episodesList.summary: Swetha advices Nandini to take a set of love tests to confirm her feelings for Chinnathambi. Later, with all the tests going positive, Nandini realises that she is in love with him.

episodesList.title: Gautham, Nandini Have a Talk
episodesList.summary: Nandini hesitates to acknowledge her feelings for Chinnathambi. Later, Gautham runs into her and tries his best to make a conversation.

episodesList.title: Prabha Gets Ecstatic
episodesList.summary: Prabha feels overwhelmed with joy when she sees Nandini and Chinnathambi together. But her happiness gets cut short when Annalakshmi behaves rudely with her.

episodesList.title: Chinna, Nandini Go for a Movie
episodesList.summary: Chinnathambi's family decides to go out for a movie. But soon things get out of hand when a few people mistreat the women in the family.

episodesList.title: Nandini's New Wish
episodesList.summary: Nandini has a late night conversation with Chinnathambi where she wishes for his love from a shooting star. On the other side, Annalakshmi gets disappointed by Chinnathambi. Why?

episodesList.title: Annalakshmi's Denial
episodesList.summary: Annalakshmi pretends to be sick and refuses to take part in the ritual. Later, Chinnathambi tries to convince her, leaving the ritual undone.

episodesList.title: Nandini Senses a Bad Omen
episodesList.summary: Nandini feels elated when Chinnathambi arrives at the temple with Annalakshmi to perform the ritual. But her happiness vanishes when she senses a bad omen.

episodesList.title: Annalakshmi Learns the Truth
episodesList.summary: Santhi reveals Gautham's identity to Chinnathambi's family and speaks ill about Nandini. Later, Annalakshmi restricts everyone from attending the felicitation ceremony.

episodesList.title: Will Nandini Save Chinnathambi?
episodesList.summary: While Chinnathambi gets all excited to attend the felicitation ceremony, Kaali appoints a henchman to kill him. However, Nandini learns about it and rushes to save Chinnathambi.

episodesList.title: Nandini Gets Stabbed
episodesList.summary: Nandini comes as a saviour to Chinnathambi but gets stabbed by the assailant. Later, Annalakshmi goes speechless after learning the truth and rushes to the hospital.

episodesList.title: Chinnathambi Breaks Down
episodesList.summary: An unconscious Nandini is rushed to the hospital in Gautham's car. Later, Chinnathambi cries inconsolably when the doctor tells him about Nandini's fight for life.

episodesList.title: Annalakshmi's Changed Outlook
episodesList.summary: Annalakshmi takes a strong stand for Nandini when a ruthless Santhi talks ill of her. When Nandini is in dire need of blood, she happily agrees to become the donor.

episodesList.title: Rajasekhar Blames Chinnathambi
episodesList.summary: Rajasekhar arrives at the hospital and blames Chinnathambi for the mishap. Later, Nandini's life falls in danger when the hospital's power supply gets disrupted.

episodesList.title: Gautham Senses Trouble
episodesList.summary: Gautham gets a whiff of trouble and plans on shifting an injured Nandini to Chennai. He manipulates Rajasekhar's mind and makes his plan successful, leaving Chinnathambi in sorrow.

episodesList.title: Police Suspect Gautham
episodesList.summary: Police interrogate Gautham about his relationship with Nandini but he lies and escapes. Meanwhile, Nandini is taken to the hospital in a critical condition.

episodesList.title: Chinnathambi Is Devastated
episodesList.summary: Annalakshmi consoles Chinnathambi when he has a nightmare about Nandini. Later, he recollects his conversation with Nandini and gets emotional.

episodesList.title: Rajasekhar in Financial Crisis
episodesList.summary: Chinnathambi refuses to eat until Nandini gets any better. Meanwhile, Rajasekhar reveals to Prabha about his financial crisis.

episodesList.title: Varsha Outwits Gautham
episodesList.summary: Gautham blurts out the truth about Nandini's mishap to Varsha. Meanwhile, Chinnathambi decides to pray for Nandini's well-being.

episodesList.title: Chinnathambi Faces Nethi-kadan
episodesList.summary: Chinnathambi undergoes Nethi-kadan for Nandini's recovery. Later, Nandini gains consciousness and longs for Chinnathambi.

episodesList.title: Chinnathambi Meets Nandini
episodesList.summary: Prabha clears the air to Chinnathambi and requests him to meet Nandini. Later, Chinnathambi arrives at the hospital and finally meets Nandini.

episodesList.title: Rajasekhar Blames Chinnathambi
episodesList.summary: Nandini's health deteriorates after an attack of fits. Rajasekhar blames Chinnathambi for her ill-health and commands him to leave the hospital.

episodesList.title: Nandini Gains Consciousness
episodesList.summary: Nandini finally gains consciousness and meets Chinnathambi. The couple shares some quality time and express their care for eachother.

episodesList.title: All Is Well with Annalakshmi
episodesList.summary: Annalakshmi apologises to Nandini for misunderstanding her all this while. Later, Prabha insists that Chinnathambi and his family stay back at Nandini's house till she recovers.

episodesList.title: Chinnathambi Yearns for Nandini
episodesList.summary: Rathanaswamy talks to Annalakshmi about her changed outlook. Later, Chinnathambi longs for Nandini and decides to pay her a visit.

episodesList.title: Kanchana's Vicious New Plan
episodesList.summary: Chinnathambi visits Nandini at the hospital to cheer her up. Later, Kanchana and Varsha humiliate him and his family by serving them English breakfast.

episodesList.title: Rajasekhar's Monstrous Act
episodesList.summary: Rajasekhar secretly getsNandini to sign the divorce papers. Later, he forbids Chinnathambi from meeting Nandini but, she finds a way out to contact him.

episodesList.title: Chinnathambi Gets Teary-eyed
episodesList.summary: Nandini feels elated when Annalakshmi showers her love and also understands her yearning for Chinnathambi. Annalakshmi goes a step ahead by performing a nethi-kadan for Nandini's speedy recovery, making Chinnathambi and Rathnasamy teary-eyed.

episodesList.title: Gautham Disturbs Nandini
episodesList.summary: Gautham meets Nandini but, she feels extremely uncomfortable with his presence. Later, Nandini gets emotional when she learns about Annalakshmi's nethi-kadan for her speedy recovery.

episodesList.title: Chinathambi's New Challenge
episodesList.summary: Rajasekhar conspires against Chinnathambi and challenges him to pay Nandini's hospital bills within two days. Helpless, Chinnathambi approaches his boss but instead gets fired from the job.

episodesList.title: Annalakshmi Is the Hero
episodesList.summary: Chinnathambi fails to arrange money for Nandini's discharge. However, in a turn of events, Annalakshmi volunteers to pay the bill by selling all of her jewellery.

episodesList.title: Nandini Is Back Home
episodesList.summary: Nandini is finally back home with everything positive around her and gets all set for a new beginning with Chinnathambi. Later, Rajasekhar apologises to Nandini. Why?

episodesList.title: Gautham's Dreadful Conspiracy
episodesList.summary: Chinnathambi smartly tricks Nandini into taking her medicines. Unable to accept their happiness, Gautham conspires against Nandini.

episodesList.title: Nandini's Sweet Gesture
episodesList.summary: Nandini insists Annalakshmi to wear her ornaments and spends some quality time with her and Chinnathambi. Later, Rajasekhar informs everyone about arranging a get-together party for Nandini's recovery.

episodesList.title: Annalakshmi's Modern Attire
episodesList.summary: Rajasekhar compels everyone to wear a modern attire for the party. Nandini takes Chinnathambi's family for shopping where Annalakshmi tries a stunning party wear.

episodesList.title: Annalakshmi Gets Annoyed
episodesList.summary: Chinnathambi, Annalakshmi and Rathanaswamy leave everyone speechless with their new look. Later, Annalakshmi gets annoyed when Rajasekhar arranges alcohol for all the guests in the party.

episodesList.title: Kanchana Executes Her Plan
episodesList.summary: Varsha imagines the consequences of Nandini getting drunk. After a lot of confusions, Kanchana serves the drink spiked with alcohol to Nandini. What happens next?

episodesList.title: Kanchana Gets Tipsy
episodesList.summary: Rajasekhar lashes out at Kanchana when she gets tipsy at the party. Later, Kanchana vows to avenge her humiliation when something untoward happens to her. What is it?

episodesList.title: Kanchana's Plan Misfires
episodesList.summary: Rajasekhar falls prey to Kanchana's revenge plan. Later, Selva and Seval compel Chinnathambi to confess his love to Nandini. Will he?

episodesList.title: Chinnathambi, Nandini's Day Out
episodesList.summary: Chinnathambi and Nandini have a fun day at the beach where he decides to give her a love letter. Later, Rajasekhar introduces Annalakshmi as a domestic help to his client.

episodesList.title: Nandini Saves the Day
episodesList.summary: Nandini gives a fitting reply to Rajasekhar for humiliating Annalakshmi. She introduces Chinnathambi and his family to the client. Later, Kaali blackmails Gautham and demands money.

episodesList.title: Annalakshmi in Danger
episodesList.summary: Gautham makes a narrow escape when Kaali deletes the messages from Nandini's phone right in time. Later, Gautham goes one step ahead and conspires a life threatening plan against Annalakshmi. What is it?

episodesList.title: Annalakshmi Rises to Fame
episodesList.summary: Annalakshmi bravely fights the goons when they try to snatch her chain. Eventually, she rises to fame as the media talk high about her heroic comeback.

episodesList.title: Chinnathambi Steps Back
episodesList.summary: Chinnathambi drops the idea of proposing to Nandini after overhearing her conversation with a friend. Later, Santhi finds Nandini's love letter and decides to make use of it to ruin her happiness.

episodesList.title: Vasudevan Makes a Move
episodesList.summary: Varsha receives Nandini's love letter for Chinnathambi and plans to use it for her good. Later, Vasudevan finds Chinnathambi working as a waiter and informs Rajasekhar about it.

episodesList.title: Rajasekhar Insults Chinnathambi
episodesList.summary: Rajasekhar storms into the house when Nandini decides to pour her heart out to Chinnathambi. Later, Nandini backs up Chinnathambi when Rajasekhar insults him for his choice of profession.

episodesList.title: Annalakshmi Gets Angry
episodesList.summary: Annalakshmi gets offended by Varsha and Kanchana's actions and decides to go back to her village. Later, Nandini reveals her plan for Chinnathambi's career to Annalakshmi.

episodesList.title: Chinnathambi's New Look
episodesList.summary: Nandini convinces Rajasekhar to appoint Chinnathambi as an employee in his company. Later, she gives him a new look and trains him on corporate skills.

episodesList.title: Nandini's Dreams are Shattered
episodesList.summary: Nandini's dreams are shattered when Chinnathambi expresses his desire to remain as a 'Brahmachari' for the rest of his life. Later, Rajasekhar agrees to appoint Chinnathambi as one of his company's employees.

episodesList.title: Chinnathambi's New Job
episodesList.summary: Rajasekhar appoints Chinnathambi as a labourer at a construction site. He commands Chinnathambi to keep it a secret from everyone in the house.

episodesList.title: Nandini Feels Elated
episodesList.summary: Chinnathambi keeps his promise and speaks high of his job in front of Nandini. She feels elated with the news and thanks Rajasekhar for helping them.

episodesList.title: Kanchana, Varsha's Dreadful Plan
episodesList.summary: Sewandhi cleverly gets her job done by Chinnathambi at the construction site. Meanwhile, Kanchana and Varsha steal Prabha's jewellery and place it in Annalakshmi's bag. Why?

episodesList.title: A Shocker for Varsha
episodesList.summary: As per Varsha's plan, police arrive at Nandini's house to investigate the missing jewellery. But, Varsha's plan backfires when the police find the jewellery in her belongings.

episodesList.title: Nandini Clears the Air
episodesList.summary: Nandini reveals to everyone about Varsha's devious plan against Annalakshmi and orders her to leave the house. Furious, Varsha vows to destroy Nandini's happiness.

episodesList.title: Swetha Blurts Out the Truth
episodesList.summary: Swetha reveals to Annalakshmi and Prabha about Chinnathambi's decision to remain a 'Brahmachari' forever. Concerned, Annalakshmi consults an astrologer, who predicts something disturbing about the couple.

episodesList.title: Annalakshmi's Clever Move
episodesList.summary: Annalakshmi leaves everyone speechless with her knowledge when the astrologer foretells a disturbing fate for Nandini and Chinnathambi. Later, Prabha calls for a grand decoration on the occasion of the couple's wedding night.

episodesList.title: A Shocker for Gautham
episodesList.summary: Chinnathambi and Nandini reluctantly agree for their wedding night. Later, Gautham's anger reaches its peak when he arrives at Nandini's house and learns the truth.

episodesList.title: Nandini, Chinnathambi's Pact
episodesList.summary: Nandini and Chinnathambi maintain a distance during their wedding night as some misunderstandings arise between them. Eventually, they decide to play normal in front of the family.

episodesList.title: Chinnathambi Gets Injured
episodesList.summary: Nandini, Chinnathambi continue to act like a real couple while the others at the house feel elated looking at them. Later, Sewanthi works on behalf of Chinnathambi when he gets fatally wounded.

episodesList.title: Gautham's Wicked Strategy
episodesList.summary: Gautham plans to do something evil when his spy informs him about the budding friendship between Chinnathambi and Sewanthi. Meanwhile, Kanchana and Varsha place a letter in Nandini's diary.

episodesList.title: Shanthi Hatches a Plan
episodesList.summary: Shanthi, Varsha and Kanchana plan to ruin Chinnathambi and Nandini's love for each other. Will they succeed in separating the couple?

episodesList.title: Rajasekhar's Cruel Act
episodesList.summary: Rajasekhar distributes salary to the labourers at the construction site. Finding this as an opportunity, he humiliates Chinnathambi and pays him a meagre amount as his salary.

episodesList.title: Nandini, Chinnathambi's Drama
episodesList.summary: Nandini and Chinnathambi go on a drive just to show the family about their growing bond. Meanwhile, Senbagam's husband, who is drunk, lusts over Sewanthi.

episodesList.title: Annalakshmi Gets Accused
episodesList.summary: Unaware of the trap set by Varsha, Annalakshmi and Malar go for jewellery shopping, where they get accused of stealing. To save Malar from humiliation, Annalakshmi takes the blame and gets insulted by every stranger visiting the store.

episodesList.title: Varsha Reveals Her Evil Side
episodesList.summary: Annalakshmi returns home as the owner of the jewellery shop finds her not guilty of stealing. She is shocked to learn about Varsha's conspiracy against her. Unable to bear it, she locks herself in the room.

episodesList.title: Annalakshmi Packs Her Bags
episodesList.summary: Despite Nandini's requests, Annalakshmi decides to go back to the village. Meanwhile, Senbagam's husband tries to physically assault Sewanthi.

episodesList.title: Nandini Finds Out the Truth
episodesList.summary: Chinnathambi comforts Sewanthi and that gets her dreaming of spending her life with him. Later, Nandini is shocked when she finds Chinnathambi working as a labourer at Rajasekhar's construction site. Will she confront him?

episodesList.title: Nandini, Chinnathambi's Clash
episodesList.summary: Rajasekhar puts Chinnathambi in a tight spot by threatening him to take all the blame for working at a construction site. Later, a major conflict arises between Nandini and Chinnathambi about the issue.

episodesList.title: Sewanthi Comforts Chinnathambi
episodesList.summary: Sewanthi tries to give an insight to Chinnathambi when he shares about Nandini's status issues. Later, the rift between the couple widens when he openly accepts his job in front of Nandini's friend.

episodesList.title: Chinnathambi Has a Heartbreak
episodesList.summary: Chinnathambi reaches a breaking point with Nandini's tantrums and lashes out at her. Later, he has a breakdown when he reads Nandini's letter for Gowtham, confessing her love.

episodesList.title: Gautham Learns the News
episodesList.summary: Gautham is on cloud nine when he learns about the rift between Chinnathambi and Nandini. On the other side, a foreteller predicts few qualities in Sewanthi's future husband. What is it?

episodesList.title: Gautham's Wicked Move
episodesList.summary: Gautham manages to create suspicion in Chinnathambi's mind. Frustrated, Chinnathambi overloads himself with work and falls unconscious.

episodesList.title: Trouble Follows Rajasekhar
episodesList.summary: Rajasekhar gets all worked up when he faces loss in business. Later, Nandini decides to confess her love to Chinnathambi, but gets interrupted when Rajasekhar has a cardiac arrest.

episodesList.title: Chinnathambi Upsets Nandini
episodesList.summary: While everyone awaits Rajasekhar's speedy recovery, Chinnathambi abruptly leaves the family in the time of need. This upsets Nandini, creating a rift between them.

episodesList.title: Nandini Takes Charge
episodesList.summary: Nandini volunteers to attend the meeting in Delhi on Rajasekhar's behalf and promises him to make it a success. Later, Nandini apologises to Chinnathambi. Why?

episodesList.title: Chinnathambi Opens His Heart Out
episodesList.summary: Chinnathambi bids goodbye to Nandini, as she prepares to leave for Delhi for business purposes. Meanwhile, Chinnathambi opens up about his inhibitions to his friends.

episodesList.title: Varsha Provokes Chinnathambi
episodesList.summary: Varsha evokes suspicion in Chinnathambi's mind by telling him about Gautham tagging along with her to Delhi. Adding to it, he feels heartbroken when Nandini lies to him about Gautham's presence.

episodesList.title: Gautham's Wise Move
episodesList.summary: Nandini opens up to Gautham about her issue with Chinnathambi. Taking advantage of this, he reveals about Chinnathambi's affair with Sewanthi.

episodesList.title: Chinnathambi's Promise to Himself
episodesList.summary: Nandini tries to clear Chinnathambi's suspicion, but Varsha interrupts the couple and worsens the situation. Chinnathambi vows to control his emotions for five days. Why?

episodesList.title: Chinnathambi Upsets Nandini
episodesList.summary: Chinnathambi's extended silence over his problems upsets Nandini. Later, she arrives at the construction site and faces Sewanthi for the first time. What next?

episodesList.title: Nandini, Chinnathambi's Clash
episodesList.summary: Nandini gets emotional when Sewanthi speaks high of Chinnathambi. Gautham's plot against the couple makes the situation worse. Later, Nandini and Chinnathambi get into a feud in front of the family members. Why?

episodesList.title: Prabha Gets Emotional
episodesList.summary: Prabha apologises to Chinnathambi on behalf of Nandini. Later, Nandini and Swetha visit the construction site to check on Chinnathambi but something unexpected shocks them. What is it?

episodesList.title: Chinnathambi Learns the Truth
episodesList.summary: Nandini misunderstands Chinnathambi and accuses him of having an illegitimate relationship with Sewanthi. Later, Varsha shows the divorce papers to Chinnathambi. Will he confront her?

episodesList.title: Nandini's Major Decision
episodesList.summary: Nandini decides to go back to the village with Chinnathambi in order to get away from all the problems. Meanwhile, Malar learns about the person conspiring against the couple.

episodesList.title: Malar Clears the Air
episodesList.summary: Malar meets Chinnathambi and discloses all the secrets about Varsha and Gautham's conspiracy against him. On learning the truth, a guilt-ridden Chinnathambi bursts into tears.

episodesList.title: Chinnathambi Confronts Varsha
episodesList.summary: Chinnathambi breaks his silence by confronting Varsha and promises to confess his love to Nandini. On learning the truth, Gautham takes Mesthri's help and stops him from going home.

episodesList.title: Varsha Blackmails Chinnathambi
episodesList.summary: Chinnathambi drowns in guilt and disgust when he wakes up next to Sewanthi. Later, Varsha blackmails him, using his intimate pictures with Sewanthi.

episodesList.title: Nandini in Search of Truth
episodesList.summary: Chinnathambi rushes out of the house teary-eyed when Nandini confronts him about Sewanthi. Later, Mesthri shows Chinnathambi and Sewanthi's intimate pictures to Nandini. What next?

episodesList.title: Sewanthi's Big Dreams
episodesList.summary: Nandini cries her heart out when she learns about Chinnathambi's betrayal. On the other side, Sewanthi dreams of a happy life with Chinnathambi and expresses her love to him.

episodesList.title: Sewanthi Learns the Truth
episodesList.summary: Sewanthi's world turns upside down after learning about Chinnathambi's true identity. Adding to her misery, Mesthri drives her away from the construction site.

episodesList.title: Nandini Rants about Her Life
episodesList.summary: While Nandini cries her heart out about Chinnathambi's betrayal, Sewanthi confronts him and demands to know the truth about their relationship.

episodesList.title: Chinnathambi Is Guilty
episodesList.summary: Chinnathambi drowns in guilt when Annalakshmi confronts him about cheating on Nandini. Later, Rajasekhar kicks him out of the house and decides to help Nandini with the divorce proceedings.

episodesList.title: Annalakshmi Bids Goodbye Chinnathambi
episodesList.summary: Ashamed of Chinnathambi's misdeeds, Annalakshmi and Rathanaswamy leave Nandini's house. Meanwhile, Chinnathambi struggles to cope up with the harsh reality.

episodesList.title: What's in Store for Chinnathambi?
episodesList.summary: Prabha tries to convince an adamant Nandini to get back with Chinnathambi. Meanwhile, unable to take the humiliation, Chinnathambi leaves for Sewanthi's village along with her family.

episodesList.title: Chinnathambi Meets Annalakshmi
episodesList.summary: Chinnathambi musters his strength to confront Annalakshmi and apologise for his mistakes. However, Annalakshmi kicks him out of the house, abandoning him on the streets.

episodesList.title: Nandini Signs the Divorce Papers
episodesList.summary: Nandini signs the divorce papers with a heavy heart. Meanwhile, Sewanthi's sister advises her to forgive Chinnathambi and get back with him. Will she do it?

episodesList.title: Chinnathambi Helps Sewanthi
episodesList.summary: Annalakshmi lashes out at Chinnathambi when he takes Sewanthi to the hospital. Later, Santhi adds on to Nandini's sorrow by talking about Chinnathambi's unapologetic behaviour.

episodesList.title: Gautham Manipulates Nandini
episodesList.summary: Chinnathambi chooses a devotional way to solve his dilemma. Meanwhile, Gautham further pollutes Nandini's mind against Chinnathambi.

episodesList.title: Chinnathambi Feels Disheartened
episodesList.summary: Chinnathambi feels his world crumbling around him when he receives divorce papers from Nandini. As a final attempt to prove his innocence, he pleads for forgiveness from Annalakshmi.

episodesList.title: Kanchana, Varsha Insult Nandini
episodesList.summary: Chinnathambi's friends advise him to meet Nandini in private to solve all the misunderstandings between them. On the other side, Kanchana and Varsha mock Nandini, leaving her in despair.

episodesList.title: Nandini Attempts Suicide
episodesList.summary: Chinnathambi arrives at Nandini's house to prove his innocence for one last time. However, Nandini locks herself and attempts to commit suicide.

episodesList.title: Nandini Has an Outburst
episodesList.summary: Nandini finally gains consciousness, only to see Chinnathambi beside her. He begs her for a chance to prove his innocence, but she kicks him out of her life.

episodesList.title: Chinnathambi Under Arrest
episodesList.summary: Chinnathambi defends himself when Rajasekhar tries to attack him. Later, he lies to the police and gets Chinnathambi arrested for creating nuisance in the family.

episodesList.title: Prabha Lashes Out at Nandini
episodesList.summary: Prabha lashes out at Nandini for aiding Chinnathambi's arrest. Later, Malar consults Aravind to help her untangle the family's mess.

episodesList.title: Nandini Lashes Out at Malar
episodesList.summary: Malar approaches Nandini to reveal Varsha and Kanchana's true colours, but she refuses to believe her. Meanwhile, an infuriated Annalakshmi warns Chinnathambi to stay away from Nandini.

episodesList.title: Sewanthi to End Her Life?
episodesList.summary: Sewanthi attempts to commit suicide. Later, Senbagam storms into Chinnathambi's house, demanding justice for Sewanthi.

episodesList.title: Prabha Advises Nandini
episodesList.summary: Prabha tries to change Nandini's decision and insists her to be patient before taking any drastic step. Meanwhile, Chinnathambi decides to be truthful in the panchayath, even if it hurts Sewanthi and her family.

episodesList.title: Chinnathambi in a Pickle
episodesList.summary: The village panchayath confronts Chinnathambi about his crimes. However, with the news of Sewanthi's pregnancy, he decides to back off from telling the truth.

episodesList.title: Nandini, Chinnathambi's Break Up
episodesList.summary: Chinnathambi's extended silence proves him guilty of having an extramarital affair with Sewanthi. Later, the village panchayath officially puts an end to Nandini and Chinnathambi's marriage.

episodesList.title: Nandini Is Heartbroken
episodesList.summary: Nandini cries her heart out when her family starts looking for a prospective groom. Later, Gautham's parents approach Nandini's family, asking her hand in marriage for their son.

episodesList.title: Chinnathambi Is Threatened
episodesList.summary: The panchayat heads threaten Chinnathambi for not taking care of a pregnant Sewanthi. Meanwhile, everyone in Rajasekhar's house is in distress when Nandini goes missing.

episodesList.title: Nandini in an Orphanage
episodesList.summary: Chinnathambi decides to take care of Sewanthi until the time is right. Meanwhile, Nandini finds peace in an orphanage and shares her painful story with a nun.

episodesList.title: Nandini Seeks Closure
episodesList.summary: Nandini decides to meet Chinnathambi for a closure and secretly follows him. Assuming Chinnathambi has moved on with Sewanthi, she decides to get married to Gautham.

episodesList.title: Sethu Makes a Move
episodesList.summary: Sethu blackmails Mesthri and Gautham of revealing their secret and demands money from them. On the other side, Chinnathambi is in shock when he learns about Nandini's wedding arrangements.

episodesList.title: Rajasekhar's Vicious Plan
episodesList.summary: Nandini lashes out at Chinnathambi when he advises her to stop the wedding with Gautham. Later, Rajasekhar invites Rathanaswamy and family to Nandini's wedding, with an intention to humiliate them.

episodesList.title: Chinnathambi Challenges Annalakshmi
episodesList.summary: Annalakshmi refuses to believe Chinnathambi when he begs her to stop Nandini's wedding with Gautham. Annoyed, he breaks all ties with his family and challenges Annalakshmi that he will stop the wedding all by himself.

episodesList.title: Chinnathambi's Quest for Truth
episodesList.summary: Chinnathambi vows to prove his innocence. Meanwhile, Sethu pressurises Gautham to fulfil his demands in order to conceal the latter's wrongdoings.

episodesList.title: Nandini Longs for Chinnathambi
episodesList.summary: Chinnathambi sets off to find the truth about his relationship with Sewanthi. Meanwhile, Nandini weeps and longs for Chinnathambi.

episodesList.title: Malar to Hack Varsha's Phone
episodesList.summary: Malar tries to hack Varsha's phone to obtain an evidence to help out Chinnathambi. Later, Nandini lashes out at everyone during her photo shoot with Gautham.

episodesList.title: Chinnathambi Confronts Mesthri
episodesList.summary: Malar helps Chinnathambi in obtaining proof against Mesthri. Later, he confronts Mesthri, putting the latter in a tight spot.

episodesList.title: Mesthri's Narrow Escape
episodesList.summary: Chinnathambi loses Mesthri in a chase. Later, Gautham teams up with Mesthri and plans for something vicious.

episodesList.title: Chinnathambi Suspects Gautham
episodesList.summary: Chinnathambi smells trouble after overhearing Gautham's conversation on the phone. Meanwhile, Nandini reluctantly takes part in her pre-wedding rituals.

episodesList.title: Annalakshmi Consoles Nandini
episodesList.summary: Annalakshmi consoles Nandini and requests her to forget Chinnathambi. Meanwhile, Chinnathambi is on the verge of proving Gautham as the culprit.

episodesList.title: Gautham in a Fix
episodesList.summary: Gautham leaves the engagement half way as he receives a threat call from Chinnathambi. Meanwhile, Chinnathambi is all set to outwit Gautham with his plan.

episodesList.title: Nandini in Sorrow
episodesList.summary: Nandini cries her heart out on recollecting her moments spent with Chinnathambi. Meanwhile, Chinnathambi hides in Gautham's car in search of the truth.

episodesList.title: Chinnathambi Visits Nandini
episodesList.summary: Chinnathambi learns about Nandini's hidden love for him. Later, he visits her and decides to quit his married life. Why?

episodesList.title: Chinnathambi Lands in Trouble
episodesList.summary: Chinnathambi comes across Annalakshmi in the hospital and vows to stop Gautham and Nandini's wedding. Later, he lands in a deep problem.

episodesList.title: Chinnathambi Gets Released
episodesList.summary: The police release Chinnathambi and arrest the culprit behind the smuggling of illegal drugs. Meanwhile, Nandini returns home from the hospital.

episodesList.title: Chinnathambi in Danger
episodesList.summary: Chinnathambi manages to reach the factory hunting for the truth. But, he gets attacked by Gautham's henchmen.

episodesList.title: Chinnathambi Learns the Truth
episodesList.summary: Chinnathambi's anger reaches its peak when he learns the truth from Kaali and Sethu. But, Gautham attacks him and tries to kill him.

episodesList.title: A Party for Nandini, Gautham
episodesList.summary: Kanchana and Varsha fear getting caught by Chinnathambi. Meanwhile, Rajasekhar throws a grand party to celebrate Gautham and Nandini's engagement.

episodesList.title: Prabha Gets Annoyed
episodesList.summary: Prabha gets annoyed with the way a drunk Gautham behaves during the party. Later, Annalakshmi and Rathanaswamy face humiliation.

episodesList.title: Gautham's Revenge on Chinnathambi
episodesList.summary: Gautham visits Chinnathambi to get his revenge.

episodesList.title: Chinnathambi Feels Shattered
episodesList.summary: Gautham promises to kill Chinnathambi right after his wedding with Nandini. Later, Chinnathambi is heartbroken to witness their reception.

episodesList.title: Nandini Calls Out for Help
episodesList.summary: With Gautham misbehaving with Nandini, she begs Prabha to stop the wedding. But, Rajasekhar emotionally pleads her to accept Gautham.

episodesList.title: Pappu Learns the Truth
episodesList.summary: Malar seeks Pappu's help to save Chinnathambi. But, Pappu refuses to believe her until she reveals her true identity.

episodesList.title: Pappu Is the Hero
episodesList.summary: Pappu outwits Mesthri and learns of Chinnathambi's whereabouts. Later, he fights the goons and saves Chinnathambi.

episodesList.title: Chinnathambi Speaks Out
episodesList.summary: Chinnathambi brings Gautham's atrocities into light during the wedding. However, everyone advises Gautham to tie the knot with Nandini.

episodesList.title: Gautham Is Proven Guilty
episodesList.summary: Police arrive at the venue with Kaali, Mesthri and Sethu to expose Gautham's crimes. Later, Nandini slaps Gautham on learning the ultimate truth.

episodesList.title: Chinnathambi's Outrage
episodesList.summary: Chinnathambi lashes out at everyone and breaks all ties with Nandini and family. Later, Prabha lashes out at Rajasekhar for being selfish.

episodesList.title: Nandini Feels Guilty
episodesList.summary: Nandini dreads the consequences and longs to meet Chinnathambi. Meanwhile, Sethu outwits Chinnathambi and escapes from his captivity.

episodesList.title: Nandini in Search of Chinnathambi
episodesList.summary: Nandini decides to defy her father and pursue Chinnathambi. Later, Sewanthi gets ready for her wedding with Chinnathambi.

episodesList.title: Chinnathambi Clears the Air
episodesList.summary: While everyone awaits Chinnathambi's arrival, he reaches the wedding venue with Sethu. Later, he unveils Sethu's crimes with a heavy heart.

episodesList.title: Sewanthi Breathes Her Last
episodesList.summary: Chinnathambi vows to protect Sewanthi and her unborn baby. But, Sewanthi consumes poison before the wedding and shares her last thoughts.

episodesList.title: A Shocker for Nandini
episodesList.summary: Sewanthi's suicide note talks about Annalakshmi's cruel behaviour towards her. Later, Nandini arrives at Sewanthi's place, only to witness her lifeless body.

episodesList.title: Chinnathambi Gets Infuriated
episodesList.summary: Chinnathambi lashes out at Annalakshmi and blames her for Sewanthi's death. Later, a hopeless Nandini yearns to get Chinnathambi back in her life.

episodesList.title: Annalakshmi Feels Guilty
episodesList.summary: Annalakshmi has nightmares about Sewanthi and feels guilty of her wrongdoings. Later, Rathanaswami feels apprehensive when he finds Annalakshmi missing.

episodesList.title: Nandini's Dream Diwali
episodesList.summary: Nandini recalls her first Diwali spent with Chinnathambi and his family. Meanwhile, Pappu's proposal leaves Malar in a dilemma.

episodesList.title: Senbagam Bids Goodbye
episodesList.summary: Nandini heaves a sigh of relief when Annalakshmi returns home. Later, Chinnathambi bids goodbye to Senbagam as she leaves the village to start a new life.

episodesList.title: Nandini Loves Chinnathambi
episodesList.summary: Selva and Sewal promise everyone that they will reunite Nandini and Chinnathambi. Later, Nandini confesses her love to Chinnathambi.

episodesList.title: Santhi's Blinded Anger
episodesList.summary: Kanchana and Varsha arrive at Annalakshmi's house. Later, a major conflict arises between Santhi and Annalakshmi, widening the rift between them.

episodesList.title: Chinnathambi's Noble Cause
episodesList.summary: Chinnathambi decides to run a charity for children and pregnant women. Meanwhile, Santhi breaks the house rule by eating non-vegetarian food.

episodesList.title: Chinnathambi in Trouble
episodesList.summary: Chinnathambi heads for trouble as he approaches Lingam for money. Later, Nandini sneaks into Chinnathambi's house to clean it.

episodesList.title: Annalakshmi, Nandini in Distress
episodesList.summary: Annalakshmi and Nandini feel distressed as they get blamed for Sewanthi's death. Later, they visit a powerful sorceress.

episodesList.title: Santhi's Vicious Plan
episodesList.summary: Selva and Sewal record Nandini and Sewanthi's entire conversation. On learning this, Santhi comes up with an evil plot against Nandini and Chinnathambi.

episodesList.title: Nandini's New Avatar
episodesList.summary: Nandini stuns everyone with her new avatar. Later, she gives it all to convince Chinnathambi and get back with him.

episodesList.title: Chinnathambi as an Auto Driver
episodesList.summary: Chinnathambi as an Auto Driver

episodesList.title: Chinnathambi's Brave Step
episodesList.summary: Chinnathambi beats up a goon who tries to harass school children. Later, Nandini bids goodbye to Prabha and Pappu.

episodesList.title: Prabha's Request to Chinnathambi
episodesList.summary: Prabha bids goodbye to Chinnathambi and requests him to reunite with Nandini. Later, Nandini and Chinnathambi watch a movie together.

episodesList.title: Chinnathambi in Trouble
episodesList.summary: Chinnathambi fails to pay the monthly interest to the moneylender. Nandini comes to his rescue and returns the money on behalf of Chinnathambi.

episodesList.title: Chinnathambi Keeps His Word
episodesList.summary: Chinnathambi finds a way to return the borrowed money to Nandini. Later, he visits Nandini and Annalakshmi at their house.

episodesList.title: Nandini, Chinnathambi Get Closer
episodesList.summary: Nandini, Chinnathambi Get Closer

episodesList.title: Nandini's Dream Diwali
episodesList.summary: Nandini recalls her first Diwali spent with Chinnathambi and his family. Meanwhile, Pappu's proposal leaves Malar in a dilemma.

episodesList.title: Nandini's Mischief
episodesList.summary: Nandini dreams of getting closer with Chinnathambi during Diwali. Later, she mischievously gets him into her captivity.

episodesList.title: Chinnathambi Fumes in Anger
episodesList.summary: Kanchana and Varsha reveal about Nandini's prank on him to Chinnathambi. Later, Nandini faces Chinnathambi's ire.

episodesList.title: Annalakshmi Advises Nandini
episodesList.summary: Annalakshmi advises Nandini as she shares the problems in her marriage. Later, Annalakshmi invites a saint to solve Nandini's problem.

episodesList.title: Varsha, Kanchana's Evil Plan
episodesList.summary: Varsha and Kanchana spread rumours about Nandini in the village. Later, Nandini faces cruel words when she performs the Nethi-kadan.

episodesList.title: Nandini's Struggles to Find Help
episodesList.summary: Nandini feels dejected as everyone in the village refuses to help her with the task. However, Chinnathambi steps forward to help her.

episodesList.title: Kanchana, Varsha's Devious Plan
episodesList.summary: Nandini is set to perform a ritual for a peaceful future with Chinnathambi. However, Kanchana and Varsha plot against her.

episodesList.title: Nandini's Love for Chinnathambi
episodesList.summary: Nandini crosses hurdles to complete her repentance for Chinnathambi. Later, Chinnathambi, unknowingly, fulfils one of her wishes.

episodesList.title: Nandini Feels Hopeful
episodesList.summary: Nandini feels hopeful after she performs a ritual for her marriage with Chinnathambi. Meanwhile, Varsha and Kanchana get ready with their next plan.

episodesList.title: Nandini Prepares for the Ritual
episodesList.summary: Nandini gets ready to perform the ritual to get back with Chinnathambi. However, things don't go as planned.

episodesList.title: Nandini Crosses the Hurdles
episodesList.summary: Nandini completes all the rituals successfully. Later, she feels elated as she spots Chinnathambi in the temple.

episodesList.title: Varsha's Cunning Move
episodesList.summary: Varsha executes her plan to stop Nandini from performing the ritual. Later, Nandini undergoes extreme physical pain during the ritual.

episodesList.title: Chinnathambi Helps Nandini?
episodesList.summary: Nandini finishes the ritual with great struggle. Later, Swetha approaches Chinnathambi for help when Nandini falls severely ill.

episodesList.title: Nandini's Stubborn Decision
episodesList.summary: Nandini goes against the doctor's advice and prepares to perform a tough ritual. Meanwhile, Santhi executes her vicious plan against Nandini.

episodesList.title: Chinnathambi Gets a Shocking News
episodesList.summary: The saint suggests another ritual when Nandini fails to complete the previous one. Later, a shock awaits Chinnathambi.

episodesList.title: Nandini in Danger
episodesList.summary: Nandini sets out to perform the ritual all alone in the forest. Gautham and Lingam decide to take advantage of this and execute their evil plan.

episodesList.title: Chinnathambi's Ultimate Move
episodesList.summary: Nandini bravely spends the night in the forest and completes the ritual. Later, Chinnathambi takes a stern decision.

episodesList.title: Nandini Becomes Homeless
episodesList.summary: Nandini sets out to accomplish her new task and ends up homeless. Meanwhile, Chinnathambi takes a major decision.

episodesList.title: Chinnathambi Meets Nandini
episodesList.summary: Nandini refuses to have the temple feast after she learns about Annalakshmi's help. Later, Chinnathambi meets Nandini and reveals his decision.

episodesList.title: Rajashekar Loses His Temper
episodesList.summary: Nandini neglects her health and continues with the atonement. Later, Rajashekar gets furious when he learns about it.

episodesList.title: Nandini, Rajashekar at Odds
episodesList.summary: Chinnathambi meets the saint and seeks his guidance to adopt a new lifestyle. Later, Rajashekar gets into a conflict with Nandini.

episodesList.title: Varsha, Kanchana's Devious Plan
episodesList.summary: Annalakshmi requests Chinnathambi to forgive Nandini. Later, Varsha and Kanchana make a new plan to obstruct Nandini's atonement.

episodesList.title: Chinnathambi Fails the Test
episodesList.summary: Chinnathambi disappoints the saint by breaking his silence whilst saving a child. Later, Annalakshmi and Nandini visit the saint for a solution.

episodesList.title: Chinnathambi Visits Annalakshmi
episodesList.summary: The saint asks Chinnathambi to seek his parents' blessings before accepting sainthood. Later, Annalakshmi feels elated as Chinnathambi arrives at her house.

episodesList.title: Annalakshmi's Painful Confession
episodesList.summary: Annalakshmi refuses to bless Chinnathambi to lead a peaceful life as a loner. Later, she makes a painful confession to Nandini.

episodesList.title: Chinnathambi's New Task
episodesList.summary: Chinnathambi blows up all his savings for a good cause. Later, Lingam arrives at the temple and donates a bundle of cash to Nandini.

episodesList.title: Annalakshmi's Drastic Step

plotHtml: It is a story about Chinna Thambi (Prajin), an innocent village boy from Chinnalapatti who falls in love with Nandhini (Pavani Reddy), an arrogant girl from Chennai. Chinna Thambi is very naive, having moral values. He obeys his mother Annalakshmi sternly and loves his family. On the other side, Nandhini is opposite like Chinnathambi, But Nandhini has a good heart. Nandhini's marriage is fixed with Gautham (Lokesh), and they get engaged. Coincidentally, one day Chinna Thambi and Nandhini meet and get into a heated argument. Chinna Thambi keeps himself away from Nandhini because he is a Baal Brahmachari. And Nandhini too dislikes him. Will they become friends and love each other? Will their love overcome their contrasting personalities, cultures, and values? On the day of marriage, Gautham is arrested for a false accusation, and a fainted Nandhini marries Chinnathambi, on the request of her parents. Then, Nandhini moves to the village with Chinnathambi. Swetha accompanies Nandhini to help her get accustomed to the new environment. At first, Nandini hates her life in the town, with small issues such as not being able to eat meat, or wear modern clothes. One day, her father-in-law (Chinnathambi's dad) hears her speak badly of chinnathambi's looks. She remarks on the clothes and hair he has, saying he has a priest's look. Her father-in-law brings Chinnathambi and changes his looks into something more modern, which shocks everyone in the house, including Nandini and chinnathambi's mother.
tagline: It is a story about Chinna Thambi (Prajin), an innocent village boy from Chinnalapatti who falls in love with Nandhini (Pavani Reddy), an arrogant girl from Chennai.

title: Chandrakanta
summary: Chandrakanta — Ek Mayavi Prem Gaatha (transl. Moonlight - An Elusive Love Story) is an Indian supernatural fantasy television series which premiered on Colors TV on 24 June 2017 and ended on 16 June 2018. Based on the 1888 novel of the same name by Devaki Nandan Khatri, it tells the story of Princess Chandrakanta. The show is produced by Ekta Kapoor and directed by Ranjan Kumar Singh under the Balaji Telefilms banner.
plot: Princess Chandrakanta Jai Singh is born to Ratnaprabha, a great magician who has the most powerful dagger of Lord Vishnu. Iravati Singh, an evil queen, wants the dagger to rule the world and conquers Vijaygarh. Ratnaprabha hides the dagger at a temple to protect it so that it could be passed on to Chandrakanta after 21 years.

articleSections.title: 21 years later
articleSections.text: Iravati still searches for the dagger. Her stepson Veer plans to conquer Suryagarh kingdom. Chandrakanta, raised by a poor couple gets the dagger but doesn't know its powers. He reaches Suryagarh, and wants revenge from Chandrakanta. However, they get romantically close and fall in love. But, Iravati succeeds in separating them. Veer unexpectedly stabs the dagger in Chandrakanta. Besides him, Iravati and her allies also brutally stab Chandrakanta, who falls off the cliff.

articleSections.title: 1 years later
articleSections.text:
Chandrakanta returns as Suryakanta. Veer has forgot their past and is a ruthless warrior under Iravati, who now owns the magical dagger. Veer eventually regains his memory and opposes Iravati. He fights her son Swayam, the beast but is unable to kill him, and finds out that Swayam is immortal blessed by Lord Vishnu. Iravati tries to find Chandrakanta. Veer receives new power of Narsimha, a powerful avatar of Lord Vishnu. Taking the form of great Narsimha, he kills Swayam and puts an end to terror of Hirnasur.
Iravati escapes and later returns. Chandrakanta gives birth to a daughter blessed to kill Iravati, who attacks Veer. She dies when Chandrakanta's daughter touches her. The daughter is named Suryakanta. In the end, Chandrakanta and Veer establish peace and prosperity in Vijaygarh.

title: Crime Alert
summary:
Crime Alert - Darna Nahin Mitana Hai (transl. Crime Alert – Don't Be Afraid, Eliminate[crime]) is an Indian crime television show that aired on Dangal and Dangal 2 as Crime Alert - Hamari Maqsad Aapki Hifaazat (transl. Crime Alert - Our Aim Is Your Safety). It was hosted by Girish Jain, Amit Pachori, Sudha Chandran (for Dangal TV), Suhaib Ilyasi and Sushant Singh (for Dangal 2). This show is based on real-life crimes in India, with dramatized reconstructions, altered names, and changed locations. A version titled Crime Alert - Jurm Ki Kahani Khud Ki Zubani aired on Dangal 2 from December. The series was produced by Filmi Nights Production House.
In 2017, the show was relaunched on Dangal TV.
In May 2025, Crime Alert - Time Aaj Ka Crime Aaj Ka has started airing on Dangal 2 with actor Sushant Singh as the host.

title: Chukbhul Dyavi Ghyavi
summary:
Chuk Bhul Dyavi Ghyavi (transl. Give & take mistakes) is a Marathi Television romantic comedy produced by Manava Naik and directed by Swapnanil Jaykar. It started airing on Zee Marathi from 18 January 2017 and ended on 29 July 2017. The show was aired every Wednesday to Saturday at 9:30 pm. It stars Dilip Prabhavalkar, Sukanya Kulkarni, Nayana Apte, Priyadarshan Jadhav and Sayali Phatak in lead roles.
The serial is based on the Marathi play of the same name, Chuk Bhul Dyavi Ghyavi, which also starred Dilip Prabhavalkar. The story revolves around the discussion between Rajabhau and Malati and whether they are an ideal couple or not and the past memory and present events of the couples.
plot:
Rajabhau Joshee and Malati Joshee are a happily married couple for 50 years. Their son, Dilip Joshee, is settled in England. Rajabhau is upset and adamant for this move, since the British ruled India for over 150 years. In his adolescence, Rajabhau wanted to get into the Indian Army, but failed to do so.
Dilip wants his parents to visit him in England and receive the award for the Most-Perfect Couple. Rajabhau tries to cancel this plan by antics with the help of his friend Tenya. So decides to walk down the memory lane with his wife and mother and decide whether they are the perfect match or not. In the process, they reveal each other's small secrets, which bring happy moments to the trio.
Finally, Malati proves that imperfect couple could be perfect match for the happiness of life, and with their son Dilip accompanying them, they convince Rajabhau to take the trip and finally visit England.

articleSections.title: Development
articleSections.text: The concept of the show is loosely based on Dilip Prabhavalkar's theatre show with the same name. The theatre show was a big success during its run and hence was adapted into a Marathi Television Series. The characters of Nali, Bandi, Uma, Kusum, Nani and few others were added to the story for the series. In the theatre show Dilip Prabhavalkar played the role of Elder Rajabhau Joshi and reprised the role in this series.

articleSections.title: Casting
articleSections.text: Dilip Prabhavalkar reprised the role as Elder Rajabhau and he also portrayed the role of his father Damodar Joshi (DaMa), while Priyadarshan Jadhav was cast to play Young Rajabhau. Sukanya Kulkarni was cast opposite Dilip Prabhavalkar where as Sayali Phatak was cast opposite Priyadarshan Jadhav as Malati.

plotHtml:
Rajabhau Joshee and Malati Joshee are a happily married couple for 50 years. Their son, Dilip Joshee, is settled in England. Rajabhau is upset and adamant for this move, since the British ruled India for over 150 years. In his adolescence, Rajabhau wanted to get into the Indian Army, but failed to do so.
Dilip wants his parents to visit him in England and receive the award for the Most-Perfect Couple. Rajabhau tries to cancel this plan by antics with the help of his friend Tenya. So decides to walk down the memory lane with his wife and mother and decide whether they are the perfect match or not. In the process, they reveal each other's small secrets, which bring happy moments to the trio.
Finally, Malati proves that imperfect couple could be perfect match for the happiness of life, and with their son Dilip accompanying them, they convince Rajabhau to take the trip and finally visit England.
tagline: Rajabhau Joshee and Malati Joshee are a happily married couple for 50 years.

title: Chahool
summary: Chahool (transl. Chirm) is an Indian Marathi language television series aired on Colors Marathi. It is produced by Aarav Jindal and Vinod Manikrao under the banner of Euphoria Productions. The show premiered on 12 December 2016 and ended on 10 November 2017.
plot: It is the story of Nirmala who has been in love with Sarjerao since her childhood. When she realises that Sarjerao, who is all set to marry a foreigner, never loved her in return, a devastated Nirmala dies of heartbreak. But true love knows no boundaries, not even that of life and death! Thirsting for vengeance, Nirmala returns to torment Sarjerao's love interest, Jenny.

title: Chandra Nandini
summary: Chandra Nandini is an Indian Hindi-language historical drama television series that aired on StarPlus from 10 October 2016 until 10 November 2017. It was produced by Ekta Kapoor under her banner Balaji Telefilms and directed by Ranjan Kumar Singh. Starring Rajat Tokas as Chandragupta Maurya and Shweta Basu Prasad as a princess Nandni, the story is loosely based on the life of Chandragupta Maurya.
plot: The show starts with a voice-over of mother India talking about Chandragupta Maurya and Nandini. A local king, Suryagupta Maurya rules the country with his pregnant wife, Moora. An invitation comes from Magadha for a festival. When they go there, the Queen of Magadha, Avantika is cheating her husband with a barber named Nanda. When Suryagupta finds it, Nanda kills the King of Magadha. Then, Nanda kills Suryagupta and becomes Mahapadma Nanda, the Emperor of Magadha. Moora escapes and delivers a boy. She hides her son in a cattle pound and is arrested by Nanda. A woman named Kanika finds Moora's son and adopts him as Chandra, unaware of his truth.
reception:
India Today quoted the series as more masala, less history and reviewed, "The creators of the show have taken generous amount of creative liberty with the original story or history. The actors are not that bad; in fact, they are pretty okay. The palace looks super-animated, like it has just been put on the screen as an afterthought."
The Times of India stated, "Going by the trailer, Shweta Basu fits the role of Chandragupta's wife perfectly. When it comes to showcasing opulence, there is no one who does it better than Ekta Kapoor. Right from the costume to the setting, one can expect grand locations and beautifully decked men and women."

articleSections.title: 8 years later
articleSections.text: Chandra lives with his adopted parents. Moora is still in Nanda's prison and waits for her son. Nanda and Avantika had a daughter, Nandini after nine sons. Meanwhile, Chandra leaves home as Kanika suffers from her husband because of him. He reaches Magadha and meets Chanakya, who tries to save Magadh from Nanda. Chanakya sees Chandra's talents and realizes that Chandra is the future king. He keeps Chandra in his presence and teaches him.

articleSections.title: 9 years later
articleSections.text: Now, Chandra is grown up and becomes talented. He tries to attack Magadha and eventually succeeds with the help of small kings. Nandini marries Chandra to save her mother and kingdom. Eventually, love blossoms between them. Nandini's twin sister, Roopa tries to kill Nandini. Nanda stabs Nandini mistaking her to be Roopa, post which Nandini realizes about Nanda's reality. Nanda and Seleucus plan to attack Chandra. Chandra convinces Seleucus not to fight against him and decides to make Nicator's daughter, Helena as the chief queen of Magadha. Chandra's second wife, Durdhara, who is pregnant, becomes sick. Helena poisons Durdhara and kills her. Durdhara's son, Bindusara was taken out by surgery. Helena makes Chandra into believing that Nandini killed Durdhara. Believing her, Chandra banishes Nandini out of Magadha.

articleSections.title: 1 year later
articleSections.text:
Chandra now lives with Helena and Bindusara. Nandini is teaching other royal kids at a Gurukul. Chandra brings Nandini back to Magadh and as Bindusara's nanny. Nanda and his minister, Amatya Rakshas send a Vishkanya (poisonous seductress) to Magadha to kill Chandra. She arrives in the Magadha as a princess Vishaka. Vishaka tries to seduce Chandra, and he pretends to fall in love with her to irritate Nandini.
Chandra decides to marry Vishaka, and he prepares for the grand wedding. Vishaka's plans to kill Chandra all go in vain every time because Nandini intervenes and saves him. Nandini exposes Vishaka, and the Vishkanya is imprisoned. Helena's mother, Apama slow poisons Nandini. Nandini is pushed into a very critical state and finally saved by Vishaka's poison. Chandra exposes Apama as Durdhara's murderer and apologises to Nandini for his mistakes.

articleSections.title: 8 years later
articleSections.text: Chandra and Nandini are leading a happy life with Bindusara. Nandini is pregnant with Chandra's child. Helena feels jealous and manipulates Bindusara into believing that Nandini had killed Durdhara in past. Blindly believing Helena, Bindusara starts to hate Nandini and decides to take revenge. In a hunting trip, Bindusara pushes Nandini from a cliff. He lies to everyone that Nandini had slipped from the cliff accidentally. Chandra grieves for Nandini's death and forgets his royal duties.

articleSections.title: 10 years later
articleSections.text:
Chandra is living like an ascetic after Nandini's unexpected death. Magadha is now under Helena's rule. Bindusara, Malayketu and Chaaya's son, Bhadraketu, Helena's children, Alice and Adonis, are all grown up. Helena is still keeping Bindusara as her puppet and poisons his mind. On the other hand, Nandini is alive and is saved by an older man. She has lost her memory and lives as Prabha now. She shares a motherly bond with the older man's granddaughter, Dharma. Prabha and Dharma visit Magadh as servants in the royal palace. Dharma started to hold a grudge against Bindusara. Chandra also finds Prabha, and he makes her his queen again. However, Helena provokes Bindusara against Chandra, which results in a great misunderstanding. Bindusara marries a princess Charumati, who ill-treats Dharma. Alice falls in love with Prince Karthikey of Champanagar and wishes to marry him. She also informs her mother, Helena. Helena decides to make Chitralekha, Karthikey's sister to marry Bindusara so that Alice can marry Karthikeyan. She prepares for the wedding ceremony. On the wedding day, Chithraleka, who is already in love with Bhadraketu, runs away and asks Dharma to replace her in the marriage. Dharma unwillingly marries Bindusara. Later he thanks her for saving his dignity and promises that he will soon break the marriage. A new problem arises when Bhimdev claims Nandini to be his wife, Savitri, who enters the palace. Chandra and Nandini's relationship is put to the test.
It is then revealed that this man is a sorcerer, and he, along with his wife Mohini, put black magic on Chandra to separate him and Nandini. They are ordered by a mysterious person named Swanand to kill Chandra. But, Chanakya finds out about the secret of Bhimdev and Mohini. Both Chanakya and Nandini save Chandra from the effects of black magic. Nandini regains her memory and realizes her true identity.
Finally, the mysterious man, Swanand, attacks Magadh and tries to kill Chandra and takeover Magadh. But, Chandra and Bindusara overpower his army, and they kill him. Chandra and Nandini are reunited. Chandra forgives Helena on Nandini's request and sends her back to Greece with her children. Bindusara apologises to Nandini for his past mistakes. He starts to like Dharma, and they all live happily.

articleSections.title: Production
articleSections.text:
This is regarded as one of the costliest series produced by Ekta Kapoor under Balaji Telefilms. On 21 September 2016, a press conference was held in Mumbai with the presence of Producer Ekta Kapoor and some actors including the leads Rajat Tokas and Shweta Basu Prasad. Director Santram Verma who directed the pilot episode of the series opted out after it and was replaced by Ranjan Kumar Singh.
In October 2016, about 300 horses were auditioned for a sequence for the lead Tokas.
Speaking about his role male lead Rajat Tokas said, "I am really looking forward to portraying the mighty king, Chandragupta Maurya. His and Nandni’s story is very different from what we’ve seen on TV so far. Theirs is a love story written with hatred." Female lead Shwetha Basu Prasad said, "This show marks my comeback on TV after quite some time. The character of Nandni is that of a strong princess, whose emotions and struggles, every woman would resonate with." During which Siddharth Nigam joined the cast as Bindusara, Avneet Kaur as Charumati. The series ended on 10 November 2017, due to fluctuations in its viewership, with Chandragupta becoming a Buddhist monk. The shooting of the series was completed on 2 November 2017.

articleSections.title: Filming
articleSections.text: The initial scenes of the series was shot in the ancient locations of Magadh and Pataliputra in Patna. But, the series was mainly filmed in Mumbai.

articleSections.title: Reception
articleSections.text:
India Today quoted the series as more masala, less history and reviewed, "The creators of the show have taken generous amount of creative liberty with the original story or history. The actors are not that bad; in fact, they are pretty okay. The palace looks super-animated, like it has just been put on the screen as an afterthought."
The Times of India stated, "Going by the trailer, Shweta Basu fits the role of Chandragupta's wife perfectly. When it comes to showcasing opulence, there is no one who does it better than Ekta Kapoor. Right from the costume to the setting, one can expect grand locations and beautifully decked men and women."

articleSections.title: Adaptations
articleSections.text: The series was dubbed in Tamil aired on Star Vijay. In Sri Lanka, the show is broadcast in Sinhala on the Swarnavahini network. In Hindi the series airs in Malaysia on TV3.

articleSections.title: Historical accuracy and inaccuracy
articleSections.text: While the character of Chandragupta and some of the wars and conflicts shown are almost historically accurate, the character of Princess Nandni of Magadha itself along with her twin Roopa is considered completely fictional by many sources. Most historians said, Chandragupta married only twice, first to Durdhara who died while giving birth to Bindusara and years after he was married to daughter of Seleucus I Nicator (Helena as per the show) in a war-peace treaty. Chandragupta defeated Selecus and then arranged a peace treaty, Chandragupta didn't convince Selecus before the war. Queen Nandni as per the show is described as daughter of the real Mahapadma Nanda which is contradicted as there is no historical evidence. It has been said Nandni's characterization is based upon most of Durdhara character derived from historical texts, novelization and poetries.

title: Chinthavishtayaya Seetha
summary: Chinthavishtayaya Seetha is an Indian Malayalam-language soap opera. The show premiered on 29 August 2016 on Asianet and aired on weekdays at 7:00 PM IST and on-demand through Disney+ Hotstar. It starred Swasika Vijay, Bipin Jose and Shanavas Shanu in lead roles. It was the first installment of the Seetha series. The show abruptly ended with 126 episodes.
plot:
Seetha is the sole bread earner of her family and is in love with Devan, a farmer, since childhood. Seetha's family wants get them married soon, but Seetha delays it due to her financial hardships.
Seetha returns Gangadaran the money which her father took as a bribe leaving Gangadaran fuming and planning vengeance. Kaveri is seen with Shayju, Gangadharan's son leaving Seetha worried. Yamuna and Sugunan try to woo Kaveri and instigate her against Seetha. She soon falls for Shayju's false love for her and curses Seetha. Simultaneously, Devan's uncle is upset at the marriage's postponement and wants Devan to marry some other girl. At the other hand, Seetha’ mother asks her to marry Devan. Indran returns from Gulf gets attracted to Seetha and wants to marry her. He bribe Narayanan to force Seetha to marry Indran. Indran also meets and plots to use Giri and Sugunan who promises to get Seetha married to him. Seetha refuses to Indran's proposal leaving Kaveri, Yamuna and Narayanan fuming. But, Seetha's mother supports her.
Narayanan loses his cool and forbids Seetha from going to work and house arrests her. Shayju and his friends plot against Kaveri and attack her but she is saved by Devan. Kaveri then realizes the true face of Shayju and supports Seetha and Devan. Seeing Seetha's plight, her mother asks her to elope with Devan. Seetha bids adieu to her sleeping father, and when Devan comes to her house to take her, he is caught by Sugunan and Indran. Narayanan insults Devan who walks away and leaving both him and Seetha in tears. Indran appoints a spy Sobhan to keep an eye on Seetha while she goes to work. Seetha vows not to marry Indran.
Soon, Kaveri and Seetha learn that Kaveri is pregnant and are shattered. Seetha counsels Kaveri and tries to persuade Shayju to unite with Kaveri. On learning this, Devan confronts Shayju for ruining Kaveri's life, while Narayanan promises the villagers to get Seetha married to Indran. Later, Indran and Shayju meet and join hands against Devan and conspire to evict Devan from their lives.

plotHtml:
Seetha is the sole bread earner of her family and is in love with Devan, a farmer, since childhood. Seetha's family wants get them married soon, but Seetha delays it due to her financial hardships.
Seetha returns Gangadaran the money which her father took as a bribe leaving Gangadaran fuming and planning vengeance. Kaveri is seen with Shayju, Gangadharan's son leaving Seetha worried. Yamuna and Sugunan try to woo Kaveri and instigate her against Seetha. She soon falls for Shayju's false love for her and curses Seetha. Simultaneously, Devan's uncle is upset at the marriage's postponement and wants Devan to marry some other girl. At the other hand, Seetha’ mother asks her to marry Devan. Indran returns from Gulf gets attracted to Seetha and wants to marry her. He bribe Narayanan to force Seetha to marry Indran. Indran also meets and plots to use Giri and Sugunan who promises to get Seetha married to him. Seetha refuses to Indran's proposal leaving Kaveri, Yamuna and Narayanan fuming. But, Seetha's mother supports her.
Narayanan loses his cool and forbids Seetha from going to work and house arrests her. Shayju and his friends plot against Kaveri and attack her but she is saved by Devan. Kaveri then realizes the true face of Shayju and supports Seetha and Devan. Seeing Seetha's plight, her mother asks her to elope with Devan. Seetha bids adieu to her sleeping father, and when Devan comes to her house to take her, he is caught by Sugunan and Indran. Narayanan insults Devan who walks away and leaving both him and Seetha in tears. Indran appoints a spy Sobhan to keep an eye on Seetha while she goes to work. Seetha vows not to marry Indran.
Soon, Kaveri and Seetha learn that Kaveri is pregnant and are shattered. Seetha counsels Kaveri and tries to persuade Shayju to unite with Kaveri. On learning this, Devan confronts Shayju for ruining Kaveri's life, while Narayanan promises the villagers to get Seetha married to Indran. Later, Indran and Shayju meet and join hands against Devan and conspire to evict Devan from their lives.
tagline: Seetha is the sole bread earner of her family and is in love with Devan, a farmer, since childhood.

title: Chokher Bali
summary: Chokher Bali (English: Sands in the eye) is a Bengali language television serial which aired on the Indian general entertainment channel Zee Bangla.
plot: Set in the early twentieth century, the story revolves around the lives of Mahendra, Ashalata, Binodini and Behari. Binodini, a beautiful young widow happened to stay with a newlywed couple, Mahendra and Ashalata. The beauty and charm of Binodini soon enchants Mahendra towards her. But as time progresses, Binodini gets drawn towards Mahendra's friend, the idealist Behari. How Binodini becomes the Chokher Bali for Ashalata forms the trajectory of the story. The story, carved beautifully by Tagore, is a reflection of man-woman relationship and much more.
