title: CID
summary:
CID is an Indian police procedural television series that premiered on Sony Entertainment Television on 21 January 1998. The series was created by B. P. Singh and produced by Singh and Pradeep Uppoor under the banner of Fireworks Productions in season 1; Deepak Dhar, Rajesh Chadha, Akshay Singh and B.P. Singh under Banijay Asia in season 2 alongside Fiction Factory. It features Shivaji Satam as ACP Pradyuman, Aditya Srivastava as Sr. Inspector Abhijeet, Dayanand Shetty as Sr. Inspector Daya, Dinesh Phadnis as Inspector Fredricks and Narendra Gupta as Dr. Salunkhe.
The location of CID is set in Mumbai. The series is one of the longest-running television series in India. The series first premiered on 21 January 1998 and aired its 500th episode on 18 January 2008, 1000th episode on 13 September 2013, 1500th episode on 4 March 2018, last episode on 27 October 2018.  The series renewed for a second season, which aired from 21 December 2024 to 14 December 2025.The second season also started streaming simultaneously on Netflix from 21 February 2025.

articleSections.text: Shivaji Satam as ACP Pradyuman (1998–2018; 2024–2025). Initially referred as Sr. Inspector Pradyuman in the first few episodes after which he got a promotion to ACP in episode "The Case of the Thief Within – I" and had been referred to ACP Pradyuman since. In "CID Par Grahan – II" , it was revealed that his full name is ACP Pradyuman Naik Satam. *Dinesh Phadnis as Inspector Fredricks "Freddy Banerjee" (1998–2018). He first appeared in episode "Kissa Raat Ke Shikhar Ka – I", but his role as Sub-Inspector started in episode "The Case of the Third Man – I" where he was initially referred as Sub Inspector Prince/Michael/Joseph but referred as Fredricks from episode "The Case of the Last Five Minutes – I". * Dayanand Shetty as Sr. Inspector Daya Gowda (1998–2018; 2024–2025). He first appeared in episode "The Case of the Anonymous Threats – I" as Sub Inspector Daya. He is referred to as Senior Inspector Daya in later episodes. * Narendra Gupta as Dr. R. P. Salunkhe (1998–2003, 2005, 2007–2018; 2024–2025). He made his debut in the episode "The Case of the Incomplete Letter", where he was initially referred to as Dr. Verma but referred to as Dr. Salunkhe from episode "The Case of the Burnt Letter – I". * Aditya Srivastava as Sr. Inspector Abhijeet Reddy (1998; 1999–2018; 2024–2025). He first appeared as character named 'Paresh', who stole ACP's gun in episode "The Case of the Stolen Gun". His role as Inspector Abhijeet started in the episode "The Case of the Stolen Dynamite – I". * Shraddha Musale as Dr. Tarika Gowda (2007–2018; 2025). Her debut episode was "The Don's Final Revenge". She re-entered in Season-2 through the episode "Death in the Jungle". * Ansha Sayed as Inspector Purvi Akkineni (2006-2008; 2011–2018; 2024–2025); she was first seen in episodic roles—as Chanda in "Case of the Double Identity", Khushi in "Case of the Bomb Robbery", Pallavi in "7 Days to Die", and Pamela in "The Gift". Her first episode as Sub-Inspector Purvi was Kissa Paagal Ashiq Kaa. * Hrishikesh Pandey as Inspector Sachin Das (2010–2016; 2025). He first appeared in episode "Khooni Deewar" under the alias Siddharth, but is later revealed to be an undercover cop and is introduced by ACP as Inspector Sachin in episode "Maut ka Aashirwad". He was last seen in episode "Bank Robbery". He re-entered season 2 through the episode "Gilheri Rakshas". Also in CID Special Bureau, he played the role of Inspector Abhimanyu. * Ajay Nagrath as Inspector Pankaj Rao (2012–2018; 2024–2025); He made his debut in the episode "CID Par Grahan – III" * Janvi Chheda as Inspector Shreya Nair (2012–2016; 2018; 2025); She made her debut in episode "Raaz Sar Aur Haath Ka" where she was introduced along with Sub-Inspector Vineet. She was last seen in episode "Maut Ka Hathoda". She returned as an Intelligence Bureau Inspector in episode "CID 20 Saal Baad". She returns in Season 2 through the episode "ACP Pradyuman tricks CID".

articleSections.title: ''CID Special Bureau''
articleSections.text:
CID Special Bureau is an Indian Hindi spinoff series of CID created by Fireworks Productions for Sony TV. The series premiered on Monday, 3 January 2005, and ended on Thursday, 2 March 2006, with 168 episodes. The series first aired on Monday and Tuesday nights, split each case into two episodes.Three cases of the series:"Bullet .11mm","Mad Bomber" and "Anokha Intequam" had crossover episodes with CID.From 29 August 2005, the series aired 4 days a week on Monday to Thursday nights with each case split across four episodes. The running time of the series was 20–22 minutes. A repeat telecast of the series aired on 6 March 2006 and ended on 27 April 2006.
^ Denotes crossover with CID

articleSections.title: ''CID Chhote Heroes''
articleSections.text:
CID Chhote Heroes is another Indian Hindi sub-series of CID created by Fireworks Productions for Sony TV. The series premiered on Friday, 1 February 2013 and ended on Friday, 24 May 2013, with a total of 17 episodes. The series was aired on every Friday nights, with each case being shown in a single episode. Two cases of the series "Daya in Danger" and "Little Comedian Kidnapped" had crossover episodes with CID. The running time of the series was 44–49 minutes.
^ Denotes crossover with CID

articleSections.title: Development
articleSections.text: CID was created by producer B. P. Singh, who co-produced it with Pradeep Uppoor under Fireworks Production. Singh in an interview, said, "The premise was simple: Seven cops and one dead body. All our episodes are based around this fact." The second season of the show is produced by Deepak Dhar, Rajesh Chadhaa, Akshay Singh and B. P. Singh under Banijay Asia.

articleSections.title: Filming
articleSections.text: , Shraddha Musale, Dinesh Phadnis, Shivaji Satam, Vaishnavi Dhanraj, Narendra Gupta, Vivek Mashru, Maninee De, Hrishikesh Pandey, Dayanand Shetty and Aditya Srivastava. CID is primarily shot in Mumbai, Maharashtra, India. During the long course of the show, the series has been shot in various locations all over India. Other locations include — Delhi, Ahmedabad, Agra, Mathura, Rishikesh, Haridwar, Kullu, Manali, Matheran, Satara, Kolkata and Mahabaleshwar among others. CID has also been shot in foreign countries. Some locations outside India include places like Uzbekistan, London, Paris and Switzerland, which included tourist attractions like Interlaken as well as cities such as Bern and Zürich. A major Paris–Switzerland shoot was done for a 2 hour special episode "Aakhri Chunauti", and a part of the production team's 13th anniversary celebration plan.

articleSections.title: CID 111 – The Inheritance
articleSections.text: CID got into both the Limca Book of Records and the Guinness Book of World Records on 7 November 2004 for its record-breaking single shot episode of 111 minutes (1 hour and 51 minutes), entitled "The Inheritance" without a cut which writer – director – producer B. P. Singh feels "every Indian should be proud of because no one has achieved this before".

articleSections.title: Broadcast
articleSections.text: The first season of CID was broadcast on Sony Entertainment Television, through its run and now the second season. The series is also aired on Sony Max, ever since it went off air. Currently, the series re-airs on Sony Pal, Sony Wah, Sony Max, Sony Aath (with Bengali dubbing) and Sony Marathi (with Marathi dubbing).

articleSections.title: Cancellation
articleSections.text: The show was decided to end suddenly by the channel and on 27 October 2018, the last episode was aired. Rumours of the show getting cancelled was going rounds while the official statement by the channel stated the show will go off air for three months to give the producers enough time to reboot it. Further it was reported that "CID is not wrapping up. But it is going on a short break and that's only for a creative reason. The makers haven't received any closure letter from the channel that proves that they are still in contract with them. The break has been decided mutually by the makers and channel as they want to reboot the show." But no announcement of it returning was made since then. Actor Dayanand Shetty who played Daya quoted that the show would not return after this break saying, "No, I don't think it's coming back. I doubt it's coming back. There can't be a break. It's just a convenient way of killing the show."

articleSections.title: Revival
articleSections.text:
On 24 October 2024, a teaser was released showcasing the return of the show on Sony TV, with a second season. The teaser revealed Shivaji Satam, Dayanand Shetty and Aditya Srivastava reprising their roles as ACP Pradyuman, Senior Inspector Daya and Senior Inspector Abhijeet respectively.
The second season started airing on 21 December 2024 and launched on Netflix as well on 21 February 2025.
The second season aired its final episode on 14 December 2025.

articleSections.title: Other initiatives
articleSections.text: On 7 July 2006, a nationwide talent hunt by Sony India. called Operation Talaash was launched in search of a new officer to join the CID team. This concluded on 1 September 2006, with Vivek V. Mashru being chosen to play Sub-Inspector Vivek. Sony Entertainment Television had launched CID: Gallantry Awards, an initiative to encourage and honour acts of bravery in society on 26 January 2010 Republic Day. The second edition of this initiative was aired on 23 January 2011. The third and fourth editions were aired on 1 April 2012 and 14 April 2013 respectively. On 10 July 2015; Sony TV announced the Shaatir Lekhak Contest, in which 3 incomplete stories and clues were presented. Contestants were required to complete any one story out of three. The contest ended on 26 July 2015. The winning story appeared in episodes and prizes were also given to the winner. From the total entries, 3 winners were selected, one for each story. The result for the winners were declared during one of the episodes of CID prior to 1 September 2015.

articleSections.title: Crossovers
articleSections.text: CID had three crossover episodes with the series Aahat, once on 13–14 November 2009, second time on 12–13 February 2010, and third time on 25–26 June 2010. It also had crossover episodes with Adaalat, once on 3–4 December 2010; second time on 14–15 July 2012 titled CID Viruddh Adaalat and third time on 20 December 2014 titled CID V/S Adaalat – Karmyudh. Also, it had a crossover with Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah titled Mahasangam, it started and ended in July 2014.. CID Team has also appeared in episode 23 of Kaun Banega Crorepati Season 8 which aired on 24 September 2014.

articleSections.title: Critical response
articleSections.text: Rediff.com gave the series 4.5 / 5 stars, and stated, "Much of the credit for CID's success should go to Singh, and its cast, especially Shivaji Satam who plays ACP Pradyuman". It stated, "Its actors, or at least the core of the cast who have been a part of the series since its inception are so popular they have become household names." Rahul Hegde of Rediff giving the same ratings stated, "The crime detective series is still going strong". The Times of India stated, "CID which has constantly entertained its viewers with unique and challenging cases is also known for its different jokes in the world of internet." Kristina Das of India Today in a retrospective review in 2020, wrote, "The show had a cult following, even the non-viewers had shown interests. Except for logic, the show had everything, literally. The concept of the show was different, a tad bit too different, you may say. But at times, the makers dragged the episodes with unnecessarily lengthy dialogues when there was no content available."

articleSections.title: Spin-offs
articleSections.text:
A spin-off CID – Special Bureau, a series about the special branch of CID which deals with cases that were left unsolved for many years aired from 2004-2006.
Another spin-off, CID – Chhote Heroes in which kids solve crimes with the help of CID aired in 2013.
A Bengali-language adaptation of CID known as C.I.D. Kolkata Bureau aired on Sony Aath from 2012-2014.
An animated series titled CID Squad based on the characters of CID began airing on Sony YAY! from 17 March 2025.

articleSections.title: Mobile games
articleSections.text:
CID - The Game, a mobile video game developed by Vroovy (a joint venture of Hungama and Gameshastra) was developed as a tie-in to the TV series.
CID Heroes - Super Agent Run, a running mobile video game has been released by Zapak and features the characters of Abhijeet, Daya and Pradyuman.

articleSections.title: Impact and legacy
articleSections.text:
, Ansha Sayed, Janvi Chheda, Shivaji Satam, Vineet Kumar Chaudhary and Aditya Srivastava, the cast of CID. CID has gained a cult status and following among the audience, owing to its episodes, cast, characters, comedy and story. CID entered in both Guinness World Records and Limca Book of Records, for shooting uncut for 111 minutes for the episode named "The Inheritance", in October 2004. Singer Lata Mangeshkar admitted to being a fan of the series.
Abhishek Raghunath of Forbes India noted: "Millions of Indians wait for CID to play out on their TV screens three nights a week on Sony. The characters—ACP Pradyuman, Sr. Inspectors Abhijeet and Daya, forensic expert Dr Salunkhe, and a host of others—have attained cult status. In an age obsessed with sex, the show is entirely devoid of it and there is no melodrama, a staple of successful Indian soaps since 1999." Rhea Candy from Film Companion stated the chemistry of the cast members and it being a family show, the main reason behind CIDs success. She added, "Today, the show incites mixed reactions. There is an acknowledgement of the institution it is; of the actors, directors and writers it has nurtured, and the efforts it has poured into churning out consistent entertainment. There are also unabashed memes inspired by CIDs peculiarities."

Little Fans of CID
episodesList.summary: Five kids in the Suryakiran Apartments play the role of their favourite CID characters in order to find their lost cat Sweety. However, their adventure is cut short as one of them named Micky stumbles upon the dead body of Jay.

episodesList.title: Devil Robbers
episodesList.summary: While a young girl waits for her friend, Happy, who has entered the departmental store to come out, she sees a gang of thieves with masked faces enter and take over the store, holding those inside hostage.

episodesList.title: The Secret of Rebirth
episodesList.summary: The CID team finds a skeleton chained to a big rock in the water. They come over to Namitha's house to ask why her and Baljeet's relationship broke.

episodesList.title: Bus Hijack
episodesList.summary: Freddie takes all of the children in his colony on a summer camp. On the way to the summer camp, the driver stops the bus because the road will be blocked with barricades. Freddie and the driver get off the bus to check and a man comes from behind and holds Freddie at gun point while a few other armed men enter the bus.

episodesList.title: The Case of the Mark
episodesList.summary: Kunal witnesses two robbers escaping from the society with a bag and a bloody knife. CID arrive to investigate the robbery and find out that a second robbery has taken place in the society, along with a murder.

episodesList.title: Brave Kid
episodesList.summary: Dhruv who was upset with his exam result. He gets lost on his way to school and while finding his way back, he sees a man exhausted from running and helps him. He gets himself in deep trouble by helping the stranger.

episodesList.title: Heroine in Danger
episodesList.summary: Tinu, who works with a tea seller, is a huge fan of Bindiya, an actress. But, Bindiya dislikes acting and is only doing it because her stepmother pressurises her. Tinu goes to the C.I.D s bureau to tell them about the imminent threat to Bindiya s life, as he fears that she may be kidnapped.

episodesList.title: Neighbor in Danger
episodesList.summary: Micky sees a woman locked in a room, as another woman drives off in a silver-coloured car. Meanwhile, the CIDs find a dying man who has been on the road. With the help of Dhenchu, the CIDs find the man s killer.

episodesList.title: The Mystery of the Tifin Box
episodesList.summary: A school teacher has been poisoned, and the CID team investigate. The man was poisoned while having food from a pupil, Guddu s lunchbox. Guddu is missing, and his friends tell the CID's that they had offered Guddu s lunchbox to the sir, without Guddu's permission.

episodesList.title: Kidnap in the Airport
episodesList.summary: Airport managers find a child, Tanya, who is lost and weeping miserably. On checking her boarding-pass they find that she has come from Mumbai to Delhi. They decide to send Tanya back to Mumbai with an air hostess to hand her over to her parents. On reaching Mumbai, Tanya goes missing again from the wash room.

episodesList.title: Daya in Danger
episodesList.summary: Ravi, a former offender, tries to kill Daya by dropping a huge concrete slab on Daya s car, but he escapes in the nick of time. Then, Daya remembers a drawing that he had got with the morning newspaper, that depicts the scene exactly.

episodesList.title: Innocent Killer
episodesList.summary: From the Autopsy, the doctor finds a piece of betel nut from Aakash's body. Taking this as a cue and with clever investigation the CID team finds the tool, which was used to murder Aakash.

episodesList.title: Murder in a Car Race
episodesList.summary: A young man dies in a mysterious go-karting accident, witnessed by his own friends & a few youn boys. However, one of the boys claim that it may not have been an accident but murder, as a few days ago all of them had almost been killed in another car accident.

episodesList.title: Little Comedian Kidnapped
episodesList.summary: Rajat learns that Roma had undergone a failed kidney transplant, and Daya and the others go their separate ways searching for the hospital where Roma had undergone the surgery for the transplant. Later, the CIDs learn that Rajat s vehicle has met with an accident, and Rajat is missing.

episodesList.title: The Secret of Absconding Girls
episodesList.summary: Damini is assumed to have eloped with a stranger. Damini's neighbour, Sunita, too is missing and is assumed to have eloped with another boy. Later, Damini's younger sister identifies a dead body as Sunita.

episodesList.title: The Secret of Treasure Hunt
episodesList.summary: Tourists, Randeep and Savita, take their daughter, Tanya, on a tour of an island. However, Randeep is forced to call the CID team when he finds his daughter missing. The CID, on their investigation, find that Tanya was involved in a treasure hunt.

episodesList.title: Code of Remote
episodesList.summary: As the CID team investigates a kidnapping case, Ajit, the director of a bio plant company whose daughter, Poonam, was kidnapped, receives a call from the culprit who asks him to produce the remote that controls the cooling plant as a ransom for Poonam. However, upon handing over the remote, he learns that Poonam has been relocated and poisoned. Ajit is then told that unless he produces the code to activate the remote within three hours, she will not be given the antidote to the poison and will be left to die.

episodesList.title: Sniper Rifle Murderer
episodesList.summary: During a critical rescue operation, Abhijeet tragically loses his daughter Shreya due to a minor error by Daya. Three months later, a mysterious shooting incident occurs on a metro, leaving a woman injured. How will ACP Pradyuman and his team uncover the truth behind this case?

episodesList.title: A Mid-Air Murder
episodesList.summary: On a mid-air flight, Abhijeet receives voice notes with certain instructions. He soon discovers a dead passenger on one of the seats. How will team CID aid Abhijeet solve the case and catch the culprit before the flight lands?

episodesList.title: Body In The Red Suitcase
episodesList.summary: During a journey from Nagpur to Mumbai, Richa's husband, Alok, vanishes under mysterious circumstances. Shockingly, his dismembered body is later discovered inside a suitcase. Who is behind this chilling crime?

episodesList.title: Chehre Par Chehra
episodesList.summary: CID officer Avni investigates a case involving her injured friend uncovering a tangled web of deception, identity twists, and a tragic past Can the team bring clarity to the chaos?

episodesList.title: Murder On The Island
episodesList.summary: Three charred bodies are discovered in a bungalow on a secluded island by catering staff. The CID team steps in to uncover the mystery behind the gruesome deaths. What secrets does the island hold?

episodesList.title: Salunkhe's Catwalk
episodesList.summary: The CID team investigates the mysterious death of Digvijay, an NRI groom, at his own wedding. As the case unfolds, they uncover a web of deception, hidden grudges, and unexpected twists, leading to a dramatic revelation about the true motive behind the crimes.

episodesList.title: Grehani
episodesList.summary: Vishal is a tech genius, whose AI, Grehani, leads to his mysterious death. The CID uncovers secrets of betrayal, rivalry, and a conspiracy surrounding the AI's dangerous potential.

episodesList.title: Bank Robbery
episodesList.summary: A bank robbery in Mumbai leaves manager Rahul as the sole victim of a planned attack. As CID investigates, they uncover a web of betting addiction, kidnapping, and betrayal involving Rahul, his sister-in-law Kanchan, and others.

episodesList.title: Twelfth Victim
episodesList.summary: A young man, Vasu, is jailed for his girlfriend Jhanvi’s murder, but years later, a serial killer confesses. CID uncovers a web of corruption, revenge, and deception tied to Jhanvi’s workplace, ultimately preventing a sinister plot and delivering justice.

episodesList.title: Jungle
episodesList.summary: A foreign photographer’s mysterious death in a forest sparks a CID investigation. As they uncover corruption, illegal activities, and local rituals, the team faces unforeseen challenges.

episodesList.title: Gumnaam Hai Koi
episodesList.summary: Tragedy strikes when a dancer suddenly collapses and dies while performing a hoola hoop routine on stage.

episodesList.title: Ready to Eat
episodesList.summary: The CID investigates a series of gruesome discoveries: fingers with numbers found in sausage packets. Tracing the source to a factory, they uncover a smuggling ring using victims to transport diamonds to Dubai.

episodesList.title: Charcoal
episodesList.summary: A corporate party turns deadly when a mysterious poison causes multiple deaths. The CID races against time, following clues to uncover the culprit and stop the poison's spread.

episodesList.title: Katputli Ka Khel
episodesList.summary: CID investigates a dancer's murder, uncovering a series of killings tied to an artistic pattern and a dark past. As they race to stop the next crime, the case leads to a dramatic showdown in an abandoned theatre.

episodesList.title: Killer Route
episodesList.summary: A series of gruesome murders targeting bus conductors on a specific route every Sunday baffles the CID, as victims are found beheaded with no trace of blood or their missing heads. Going undercover as conductors, the CID team hunts for the elusive killer.

episodesList.title: The Last Fight
episodesList.summary: The sudden death of a very famous underground fighter, Vikram in the ring. His girlfriend, sensing the situation, calls the CID.

episodesList.title: Flat No 403
episodesList.summary: A gunshot echoes through a society, leading CID to Vikrant's flat, where they find bloodstains and a skull on the wall. What mystery lies behind this chilling scene?

episodesList.title: Mechanical Trap
episodesList.summary: A deadly threat frames CID, putting Daya under suspicion. As the team investigates, they uncover a web of deception and the real mastermind behind the setup.

episodesList.title: Haunted House
episodesList.summary: Rajveer and his friends discover bloodstains in an abandoned bungalow and alert the CID. As the team investigates, they uncover something suspicious.

episodesList.title: Murder In The House
episodesList.summary: A woman is found dead in her home after a chandelier mysteriously falls on her. As CID investigates, they uncover suspicious details surrounding the incident.

episodesList.title: Gilheri Rakshas
episodesList.summary: A man discovers a dead body in the forest and suspects the Gilheri Rakshas is behind it. Can CID uncover the truth?

episodesList.title: Death Of A Therapist
episodesList.summary: Inspector Abhijeet discovers Dr. Meera dead at her clinic. As CID investigates, their search leads them to a Softech Solutions company. Who is behind the murder?

episodesList.title: Not Guilty
episodesList.summary: After an accident on a jungle road, Akshita seeks refuge with Dr. Salunkhe, who tries to shield her. As CID investigates, hidden truths unravel, leading to a shocking revelation.

episodesList.title: Curse Of The Burning Man
episodesList.summary: A man is found dead with burning footprints leading away. As the CID investigate, they uncover a deadly plot tied to an old shipyard legend.

episodesList.title: Swimmers
episodesList.summary: Three state-level swimmers go for a swim, but when one of them is found dead under mysterious circumstances, CID steps in. As they investigate, dark secrets and a cunning murder plot unravel, leading to a shocking truth.

episodesList.title: Room No 804
episodesList.summary: A man checks into Forest Woodland Resort only to realize that the eighth floor, which existed earlier, has mysteriously vanished. Later, CID arrives to investigate the murder of a girl found in Room 408. What is the truth behind this baffling case?

episodesList.title: Baby Steps
episodesList.summary: A yoga instructor, Rohini, mysteriously dies while on a call with CID, with only her baby present. Soon, another instructor, Puja, also dies. CID discovers both were killed remotely using Bluetooth hacks. How will CID solve this case?

episodesList.title: The Talking Skeleton
episodesList.summary: CID investigates a restaurant staff member’s death and uncovers hidden remains in a statue. As more victims emerge, they follow clues leading to a smuggling operation. How will CID get to the bottom of the case?

episodesList.title: Men's Premier League
episodesList.summary: The CID team is thrown into action when a biker hurls a duffel bag onto their car, raising bomb concerns. Upon inspection, they find cash and a tape recorder exposing a syndicate linked to match-fixing, with clues tied to cricket.

episodesList.title: Nakabposh
episodesList.summary: While Inspector Abhijeet pursues a criminal, he meets a man at a bus stop who claims to have a vision of a girl being murdered, with her hair being cut off. Soon after, CID investigates a case that matches his eerie prediction. Is this coincidence or something more sinister?

episodesList.title: The End Of The Watch
episodesList.summary: CID uncovers a bomb plot, only to realize it’s a trap by Barboza of the Golden Eye Gang. He hijacks the bureau and successfully kills ACP Pradyuman. Is this end of CID and ACP Pradyuman?

episodesList.title: The Aftermath
episodesList.summary: Barboza makes a threatening call to Daya, revealing ACP’s death. As the team reels from the loss, they prepare to take down Barboza and his gang. Meanwhile, Sachin remains in the ICU and Avni battles her injuries.

episodesList.title: Ticket To Heaven
episodesList.summary: Rajeev, a shopkeeper, is found dead on a bus under alarming circumstances - his face had turned cherry red with signs of rapid rigor mortis. CID officers Purvi and Pankaj are joined on the case by a couple of other officers, who doubt the team's capabilities in ACP Pradyuman's absence.

episodesList.title: Purze
episodesList.summary: ACP Ayushmaan arrives as the new ACP and sets boundaries before the team. Team CID then investigates the cases of gruesome, organ-harvesting murders, where the victims are abducted and are operated on when alive.

episodesList.title: Murder At The Studio
episodesList.summary: Podcaster Aniket, who had recently uncovered the identity of the culprit behind a two-year-old murder case, is found dead in his studio with his throat slit. ACP Ayushmaan and the CID take charge of the investigation to uncover the truth behind this chilling crime.

episodesList.title: Murder At The Railway Tracks
episodesList.summary: A girl is found dead near the Mahim railway tracks, prompting CID to take charge of the investigation. Meanwhile, Sachin notices something suspicious about the victim's footwear and urgently asks to speak with Inspector Daya,

episodesList.title: Death In The Car
episodesList.summary: A company prepares for a grand launch of its latest car, meant to showcase the future of automobiles. But during the big reveal, a corpse is discovered in the driver's seat. How will CID solve the case?

episodesList.title: The Silent Den
episodesList.summary: A mysterious murder takes place inside a silent den, leaving Team CID with no clear leads. As suspicion spreads among the staff and guests, will they be able to uncover the killer hiding in plain sight?

episodesList.title: CID Mein Gaddar
episodesList.summary: Team CID arrives at a school under threat from an unknown man. Meanwhile, ACP Pradyuman and ACP Ayushmaan clash over the Barboza case, with Ayushmaan suspecting a mole within their own team

episodesList.title: Accidental Death Or A Planned Murder?
episodesList.summary: Two celebrities from a reality show meet a mysterious end, sending shockwaves through the industry. As the investigation unfolds, team CID is soon alerted to yet another tragic incident - the accidental death of rising star Dhwani. Are these deaths truly accidents, or is there a sinister plot at play? With the pressure mounting, CID races against time to uncover the truth and bring the culprits to justice.

episodesList.title: The Last Stroke
episodesList.summary: A painter is found dead in his art gallery while working on a painting. As CID begins their investigation, they discover a lipstick mark on a cup, a diary, a photograph, and a mobile phone. Can these clues lead them to the killer?

episodesList.title: Missing Flight
episodesList.summary: Team CID is left baffled when they discover a corpse strapped to a seat, resembling a pilot who appears to have crashed. What is the mystery behind this strange death?

episodesList.title: The Mysterious Death Of A Businessman
episodesList.summary: A successful businessman is found dead while swimming in his pool at his farmhouse. Team CID investigates the case and is unable to find the cause of the death of the businessman. Soon after, another man is murdered. How will the team crack the cases?

episodesList.title: Skeleton At A Construction Site
episodesList.summary: CID team takes on a new case involving a skeleton found buried in the ground. With no initial clues, how will the team unravel the mystery?

episodesList.title: Case Of Real Diamonds
episodesList.summary: Two men are brutally murdered on the same night, one at home and the other at his office. The CID begins investigating and finds a diamond studed vase in both the crime scenes. Could there be a connection between the two cases?

episodesList.title: The Last Call
episodesList.summary: Unknown calls trigger deadly phone explosions across the city. CID discovers chips secretly installed in phones via a fake repair campaign. Linked to the old EchoNet project, the mastermind remains unknown.

episodesList.title: Jewellery Theft
episodesList.summary: A raid turns shocking when CID uncovers stolen jewellery in a godown - alongside Inspector Daya's badge. As suspicion clouds the team, a second daring heist strikes another jewellery store, carried out by masked men. Is Daya truly behind it, or is someone framing him?

episodesList.title: ACP Pradyuman Is Alive?
episodesList.summary: Daya tells the CID team that ACP Pradyuman is alive-but in a shocking twist, he reveals that the ACP failed to recognize him and opened fire. As the team reels from the news, Daya exposes a dark secret about Barboza and his gang that shakes them to the core. Can CID reach ACP Pradyuman before it's too late?

episodesList.title: ACP Pradyuman Tricks CID
episodesList.summary: ACP Pradyuman escapes with Barboza, deceiving the entire CID team. When he walks into the bureau, Abhijeet refuses to believe his story. Later, ACP reveals the shocking truth behind how he survived the bureau blast.

episodesList.title: Accident Or Murder?
episodesList.summary: Purvi comes under suspicion as the team believes she's the mole, until the DIG arrives just in time to defend her. Meanwhile, CID investigates a minor car crash with a shocking twist. Was the driver killed in the accident, or was he already dead before the impact?

episodesList.title: Behind the Glamour
episodesList.summary: Ira, an actress who had bagged a coveted role, is found hanging in her apartment. Team CID investigates the case as they find out about Ira's rival. Who killed Ira, and why?

episodesList.title: Death In The Jungle
episodesList.summary: While trekking, four friends stumble upon a headless body deep in the jungle. When CID investigates, they find something even stranger - the body has no blood. With no clues and rising fear, can CID uncover the truth behind this eerie mystery?

episodesList.title: Dead Men In Uniform
episodesList.summary: A group of kids find a gun in their society. Soon after, a policeman falls to his death. A young girl silently sees someone who looks like Daya behind a mask. Later, two more police officers are murdered. What is this case really about?

episodesList.title: Janamdin Par Maut
episodesList.summary: Officer Daya tampers some of the evidence of a case. Parallelly, a man is murdered as he enters his house for his surprise birthday party. Notably, while waiting for Salil to return, Dodo makes a statement about the incident of a man being killed on his birthday. Who killed Salil and why?

episodesList.title: Omkar Sawant Joins The Team
episodesList.summary: Daya shoots Inspector Milan on a moving bus. As CID begins their investigation, Superintendent Omkar Sawant joins the team. While interrogating the passengers, they uncover four distinct personalities within the same man. Can they reach Daya in time and will Inspector Milan survive?

episodesList.title: Omkar Sawant Has A Breakthrough
episodesList.summary: Superintendent Omkar Sawant announces that the death of Officer Milan has resulted in a breakthrough in the case. Soon after, he states that he has been tracing Officer Daya's moves. Meanwhile, team CID is notified about murder cases that lead to similar, torturous deaths of different victims.

episodesList.title: Officer Daya Is On The Run
episodesList.summary: Officer Daya disguises himself and boards a flight. The same flight happens to get hijacked. With team CID on the hunt for Officer Daya, will he be able to save the passengers, conceal his identity, and get away without drawing any attention towards him?

episodesList.title: An Encrypted Message
episodesList.summary: Team CID raids Officer Daya's house and discovers that he has escaped in disguise. While Officer Daya takes Shreya's help once he lands in Delhi, some of the members of Team CID decrypt his secret message left behind. What will the encrypted message lead to?

episodesList.title: Purvi Receives A Message
episodesList.summary: While team CID surrounds the Governor's residence, Daya succeeds in sending an encrypted message to Purvi. Daya and Shreya continue working on their operation. Will Purvi be able to decipher Daya's message?

episodesList.title: Double Agent Daya
episodesList.summary: When Omkar Sawant exposes Daya's truth, Abhijeet defends him and reveals the real mastermind. As Purvi and Abhijeet enter the building to rescue Daya and the Governor, will their mission succeed?

episodesList.title: Team CID On A Vacation
episodesList.summary: While team CID is on vacation at a resort, they discover that a comedian's manager named Mohan has been murdered after being hit on the head by a coconut. Can they solve the case while still on holiday?

episodesList.title: Officer Purvi's Narrow Escape
episodesList.summary: Team CID finds out the cause of Tanya's death. Soon after, Officer Purvi narrowly escapes acid being flung towards her. On further investigation, the team narrows down the list of suspects. Will the culprit outwit team CID?

episodesList.title: Ekk Anokha Case
episodesList.summary: Sarthak, a man who is found dead, writes in his suicide note about murdering somebody else. Team CID has 72 hours to crack the case and save the life of the victim. Who is the victim and why did Sarthak kill him before dying?

episodesList.title: Dr Salunkhe Goes Missing
episodesList.summary: With only 42 hours left, Dr. Salunkhe is missing. Meanwhile, the man impersonating him is found dead inside the jail. During the investigation, it is revealed that someone posing as Daya had visited Dr. Salunkhe in jail. Will CID be able to find the real Dr. Salunkhe and uncover the cure for the poison in time?

episodesList.title: CID Ke Naam Ek Gift
episodesList.summary: ACP Pradyuman receives a mysterious call about a gift from someone calling himself the Chessmaster. CID finds themselves caught in a real-life game of chess as they race to solve the case. What danger lies ahead for the team?

episodesList.title: Ekk Insaan, Do Maut
episodesList.summary: Team CID investigates the death of a man and finds out that he has died twice. How will the team uncover this curious mystery, and what is the cause of the death?

episodesList.title: Accident Ya Murder?
episodesList.summary: A bike accident takes a shocking turn when the autopsy reveals hidden truths. The team begins to suspect foul play. Was it really an accident or a cleverly planned murder? The race to find out the truth begins.

episodesList.title: Officer Abhijeet Witnesses A Crime
episodesList.summary: While recovering at home from an injury, Officer Abhijeet believes that he has witnessed a crime take place in the apartment opposite his. Officer Daya arrives at the aforesaid apartment and finds the apartment bare. Team CID investigates whether a crime has taken place or if Officer Abhijeet is hallucinating.

episodesList.title: Failed Transactions
episodesList.summary: Multiple payment transactions fail across the city. Meanwhile, CID probes an accident involving a doctor set to receive an award on 15th August, only to discover he was responsible for YPI transaction security. What mystery will this investigation uncover?

episodesList.title: Shraap
episodesList.summary: CID investigates a case in a chawl where young Prasad collapses during Dahi Handi practice, his body twisted backwards from the waist. While an old lady calls it a curse, will CID uncover the real cause?

episodesList.title: Dead Principal
episodesList.summary: The principal of a college is found dead under mysterious circumstances. When CID investigates, they find red powder in his nails and deep scratches on his neck. Their suspicion falls on Professor Ajit, but is he really behind the murder or is there more to the case?

episodesList.title: Do Minute, Do Khoon
episodesList.summary: As the organisers at Lunaro Art Gallery gear up for their most anticipated exhibition, Dr Myra and Vikram are found murdered. Team CID investigates the case but gets trapped at the gallery when the anti-theft alarm goes off. Will they solve the crime with depleting oxygen levels in the gallery?

episodesList.title: Manch Par Maut
episodesList.summary: Amid Ganpati celebrations, the CID team is called in to investigate the mysterious death of a famous dance teacher. While it appears to be a heart attack, suspicions of murder grow stronger. Will the truth come out?

episodesList.title: The Headless Dead Body
episodesList.summary: Team CID investigates the case of a headless dead body found in a trunk on top of a bus. Who is the victim, why was he murdered and who is the culprit?

episodesList.title: An Author's Murder Mystery
episodesList.summary: While Team CID is busy playing a game of chess, they receive news of the murder of renowned novelist Surya. The case appears to be a natural death at first, until they discover a burnt paper with details about the murder in his room. How will CID unravel this mystery?

episodesList.title: A Serial Killer's Revenge
episodesList.summary: Chaos erupts when a feared serial killer breaks free, determined to hunt those behind his arrest. As fear grips the city, the CID team must stay one step ahead and track him down before his deadly revenge claims more victims.",shortDescription:"Chaos erupts when a feared serial killer breaks free, determined to hunt those behind his arrest. As fear grips the city, the CID team must stay one step ahead and track him down before his deadly revenge claims more victims.

episodesList.title: Shooting Stars
episodesList.summary: Arpan mysteriously dies moments after proposing to his girlfriend through a video under a shooting star. When the CID begins its investigation, they discover his charred body at the very spot of the attack. Was Arpan truly killed by a celestial phenomenon, or is there a darker conspiracy at work?

episodesList.title: High Security Murder
episodesList.summary: Abhijeet receives a threat that his friend Dhanraj's life is in danger. With Dhanraj under high-profile security, can Abhijeet reach him before it's too late?

episodesList.title: Haunted Amusement Park
episodesList.summary: A social media experiment to revive an abandoned amusement park turns sinister when an influencer dies mid-stunt. Can the CID team uncover the dark truth hidden inside?

episodesList.title: Bureau Mein Murder
episodesList.summary: A man walks into the CID bureau to report a threat to his life and warns ACP Pradyuman about an impending attack in Mumbai. But before he can say more, he suddenly dies right there in the bureau. How will ACP Pradyuman and his team uncover the truth behind this case?

episodesList.title: Influencer Ki Maut
episodesList.summary: On being called by Shanaya's concerned manager, team CID smashes Shanaya's door and finds her murdered. The top suspects involve Shanaya's current boyfriend and her ex-boyfriend. Based on the postmortem results, team CID hunts for an important clue. How will they catch the murderer?

episodesList.title: Pariyon Ki Duniya
episodesList.summary: CID takes on a baffling case where people act possessed, speak of a fairyland, and then die by suicide. With no substances found in their bodies and all deaths occurring at the same time, what is really behind this mystery?

episodesList.title: A Poisoned Necklace
episodesList.summary: Shreya arrives to attend the engagement ceremony of Rashi and Aman. Soon after, Rashi is found murdered after having wom a poisoned necklace. Team CID investigates the case and finds out that a slow poison was being administered to Rashi since a while. Who is the culprit and why was Rashi murdered?

episodesList.title: Curious Case Of Artificial Intelligence
episodesList.summary: Cricketer Neerav's daughter is kidnapped from school, and CID steps in to investigate. They discover that an unknown person picked her up claiming to have Neerav's permission. How will CID crack the case?

episodesList.title: Murder At The Resort
episodesList.summary: Team CID reaches a resort to investigate the mysterious death of a young girl. Upon inspection, they discover she was stabbed in a fit of rage. Will CID uncover the truth behind Surbhi's death while questioning her friends?

episodesList.title: Deadly Overtime
episodesList.summary: A woman is murdered under mysterious circumstances while working late in her office. The CID team notices something strange in the CCTV footage. Motion sensors detect movement but no body appears. Forensics reveal unusual entry and exit wounds. Can the team solve this baffling case?

episodesList.title: Bungalow Mein Maut
episodesList.summary: CID investigates a shocking case where a man named Kunal is found dead, but the police discover that Kunal himself had reported his own death before it happened. What is the mystery behind this eerie case?

episodesList.title: An Obsessed Fan
episodesList.summary: Neha is found dead in actress Aisha's green room, stabbed in the back with a pair of scissors. During the investigation, Pankaj discovers a strange necklace with Aisha's photo made from blue hair. What dark secret lies behind this eerie clue?

episodesList.title: RJ Ki Maut
episodesList.summary: Pankaj is on a call with RJ Rishabh when suddenly, the RJ calls out for help and is then found murdered. When team CID investigates the case, they find a few dead honeybees in the room. Who is the culprit and why was the crime committed?

episodesList.title: Karmo Ka Phal
episodesList.summary: A man is found dead with his face crushed by a stone and a message scrawled in his blood at an isolated spot with no CCTV. Was his death a personal vendetta, or is there a darker motive behind it?

episodesList.title: Death Of A Fortune Teller
episodesList.summary: A crowd gathers to hear messages from their ancestors through a woman, but suddenly the woman collapses and dies right before their eyes. When CID arrives to investigate, they discover someone else's blood stains at the scene. What dark truth lies behind this mysterious case?

episodesList.title: Buried In Cement
episodesList.summary: A unique case comes up for the CID team when a body is discovered buried in cement inside an abandoned bungalow. What clues will the team uncover from this corpse that has been lying there for months?

episodesList.title: Cursed Mirror
episodesList.summary: Actress Reva is found unconscious after a mysterious accident that appears to be deliberate. When CID takes charge of the investigation, they discover that Reva possessed a cursed mirror. What dark secret lies behind this shocking incident?

episodesList.title: Death After Discharge
episodesList.summary: Dhiren, a businessman, is found dead in his car after being discharged from the hospital. Team CID investigates the case and finds out more about his family dynamics and the ongoing politics in his business. Who murdered Dhiren and why?

episodesList.title: Maut Ki Dhamki
episodesList.summary: Businessman Kuldeep receives a threatening phone call over a bungalow dispute and is later found dead in his meditation room. Team CID investigates the case and discovers a broken window and aroma oil on his face. Who killed Kuldeep?

episodesList.title: Apsara
episodesList.summary: While team CID heads out for a picnic, they stumble upon a mysterious case involving a missing policeman. The prime suspect is a woman who lives by the lake and is known to lure men with her charm and jewellery. As the team dives deeper into the investigation, they uncover multiple corpses hidden beneath the lake's surface. What dark secret lies behind this eerie mystery?

episodesList.title: Ekk Anokha Shadyantra
episodesList.summary: Team CID investigates a case where they find a woman's body without the head. The entire team stitches various clues together and identifies the victim to be Alisha. On further investigation, the team narrows down the flow of the events leading to the murder. Who murdered Alisha and why?

episodesList.title: A Chain Of Murders
episodesList.summary: The CID team stumbles upon a strange case where an auto-rickshaw driver is found strangled to death with no signs of struggle and no witnesses. Soon after, another eerily similar death is discovered not far from the first scene. Is a serial killer on the loose, or is there a deeper connection behind these murders?

episodesList.title: SOS Call
episodesList.summary: Team CID follows a set of coordinates to a secluded location after receiving an SOS call. As they begin their search, they try to track down Officer Shreya and a woman named Sarla who was with her. What mystery lies behind this case, and where have Shreya and Sarla disappeared?

episodesList.title: Rakshak Baba
episodesList.summary: Three friends trespass onto land owned by Rakshak Baba. One escapes, but the other two are found decapitated and their bodies discovered deeper in the forest. How will CID piece the case together?

episodesList.title: The Ghost Of Kalighati Village
episodesList.summary: While on vacation, Daya discovers a village plagued by murders. Locals claim a witch is behind these deaths. Can he uncover the truth?

episodesList.title: Murder At The Bureau
episodesList.summary: When a serial killer dies in CID custody, suspicion falls on Abhijeet. ACP Pradyuman defends him as the team fights to clear his name.

episodesList.title: Abhijeet's Secret Caller
episodesList.summary: A truck driver named Munna is found dead and his partner is missing. CID is stunned to discover that the RDX once loaded in the truck has vanished. During the investigation, Abhijeet receives a rose and a call from a mysterious woman asking for help. Are these two incidents connected?

episodesList.title: Abhijeet Shoots Daya
episodesList.summary: With Abhijeet suspected of having gone rogue, team CID attempts to track 400 kg of RDX across the city. The team follows a lead and tracks delivery boys in the city. Shortly after, during a shootout, Abhijeet fires at Daya before escaping. What is Abhijeet's plan?

cast.name: Shivaji Satam
cast.role: ACP Pradyuman (1998–2018; 2024–2025). Initially referred as Sr. Inspector Pradyuman in the first few episodes after which he got a promotion to ACP in episode "The Case of the Thief Within – I" and had been referred to ACP Pradyuman since. In "CID Par Grahan – II" , it was revealed that his full name is ACP Pradyuman Naik Satam.

cast.name: Dinesh Phadnis
cast.role: Inspector Fredricks "Freddy Banerjee" (1998–2018). He first appeared in episode "Kissa Raat Ke Shikhar Ka – I", but his role as Sub-Inspector started in episode "The Case of the Third Man – I" where he was initially referred as Sub Inspector Prince/Michael/Joseph but referred as Fredricks from episode "The Case of the Last Five Minutes – I".

cast.name: Dayanand Shetty
cast.role: Sr. Inspector Daya Gowda (1998–2018; 2024–2025). He first appeared in episode "The Case of the Anonymous Threats – I" as Sub Inspector Daya. He is referred to as Senior Inspector Daya in later episodes.

cast.name: Narendra Gupta
cast.role: Dr. R. P. Salunkhe (1998–2003, 2005, 2007–2018; 2024–2025). He made his debut in the episode "The Case of the Incomplete Letter", where he was initially referred to as Dr. Verma but referred to as Dr. Salunkhe from episode "The Case of the Burnt Letter – I".

cast.name: Aditya Srivastava
cast.role: Sr. Inspector Abhijeet Reddy (1998; 1999–2018; 2024–2025). He first appeared as character named 'Paresh', who stole ACP's gun in episode "The Case of the Stolen Gun". His role as Inspector Abhijeet started in the episode "The Case of the Stolen Dynamite – I".

cast.name: Shraddha Musale
cast.role: Dr. Tarika Gowda (2007–2018; 2025). Her debut episode was "The Don's Final Revenge". She re-entered in Season-2 through the episode "Death in the Jungle".

cast.name: Ansha Sayed
cast.role: Inspector Purvi Akkineni (2006-2008; 2011–2018; 2024–2025); she was first seen in episodic roles—as Chanda in "Case of the Double Identity", Khushi in "Case of the Bomb Robbery", Pallavi in "7 Days to Die", and Pamela in "The Gift". Her first episode as Sub-Inspector Purvi was Kissa Paagal Ashiq Kaa.

cast.name: Hrishikesh Pandey
cast.role: Inspector Sachin Das (2010–2016; 2025). He first appeared in episode "Khooni Deewar" under the alias Siddharth, but is later revealed to be an undercover cop and is introduced by ACP as Inspector Sachin in episode "Maut ka Aashirwad". He was last seen in episode "Bank Robbery". He re-entered season 2 through the episode "Gilheri Rakshas". Also in CID Special Bureau, he played the role of Inspector Abhimanyu.

cast.name: Ajay Nagrath
cast.role: Inspector Pankaj Rao (2012–2018; 2024–2025); He made his debut in the episode "CID Par Grahan – III"

cast.name: Janvi Chheda
cast.role: Inspector Shreya Nair (2012–2016; 2018; 2025); She made her debut in episode "Raaz Sar Aur Haath Ka" where she was introduced along with Sub-Inspector Vineet. She was last seen in episode "Maut Ka Hathoda". She returned as an Intelligence Bureau Inspector in episode "CID 20 Saal Baad". She returns in Season 2 through the episode "ACP Pradyuman tricks CID".

cast.name: Afshan Khan
cast.role: Sub-Inspector Mridula (1998). She first appeared in episode "Case of the Thief Within – I".

cast.name: Ashutosh Gowariker
cast.role: Sr. Inspector Virendra (1998–1999). He first appeared in episode "The Case of the Thief Within – I". His last episode in the show was episode "The Case of Missing Fugitive – II". He was transferred.

cast.name: Ashwini Kalsekar
cast.role: Sub-Inspector Asha (1998–2004). She first appeared in the episode "The Case of Second Statement – I". Her last episode was episode "Case of the Dazed Man – II".

cast.name: Manoj Verma
cast.role: Sub Inspector Vikram Shinde/Sub Inspector Sawant (1998). He first appeared in episode "Case of the Poison - I".

cast.name: Dhananjay Mandrekar
cast.role: Sub-Inspector Sudhakar (1998–2005). He appeared as Sub Inspector Bhonsle in starting episodes but after episode 35 he was referred as Sub Inspector Sudhakar. He was last seen in "The Case of the Stolen Ring – I".

cast.name: Vaquar Shaikh
cast.role: Inspector Jeet (1998). He appeared in episode "The Case of the Contract Killer"

cast.name: Dilip Kulkarni
cast.role: DCP Dipankar Deshmukh (1998–2005). He was first seen in episode "The Thief Within - I" and was last seen in "The Case of the Invisible Bullet- II".

cast.name: Sanjeev Seth
cast.role: Sub-Inspector Sanjeev (1998). He first appeared in episode "The Case of the Anonymous Threats – I". Additionally, he also appeared as a case victim named Sanjeev in episode "The Case of The Red Cloth – I".

cast.name: Tushar Dalvi
cast.role: Inspector Jayant (1999). He first appeared in "The Case of Cross Connection – I". He was last seen in "The Case Of Stolen Dynamite – ll".

cast.name: Manav Gohil
cast.role: Inspector Daksh (2004–2005) His first episode as a cop was "Trust Me, Trust Me Not – I". His last episode was "Trail in London – II". He was killed by Nakul.

cast.name: Smita Bansal
cast.role: Inspector Aditi (2004–2005) Her first episode was "The Case of the Haunted Building – I". Her last episode was "Mad Bomber – II". She died in the episode.

cast.name: Surendra Pal
cast.role: DCP (2005). His first episode was "The Case of the Killer Lake – l". He was last seen in episode "Face Off – lll".

cast.name: Kavita Kaushik
cast.role: Sub-Inspector Anushka (2005–2006). She appeared in episodes "Trail in London" (all parts) as a Central Intelligence Sub-Inspector who secretly helps ACP Pradyuman. She enters CID in episode "Poison In The Nail – l". Her last episode was "Secret of the Code No. 571E1115".

cast.name: Sai Deodhar
cast.role: Sub-Inspector Priyanka (2005) Her first episode was "Case of the Dead Waiter – I". Her last episode was "Trail in London – lll"

cast.name: Rajeev Khandelwal
cast.role: ACP Prithviraj (2005, 2008) He appeared as the ACP in episodes: "Face Off – lll & lV" and "Trail in London" (all parts) when ACP Pradyuman was in London for the investigation. He was also in the episode "The Case of the Missing Bride" as himself.

cast.name: B. P. Singh

title: Captain Vyom
summary: Captain Vyom is an Indian television series aired on DD National in 1998. It was directed by Ketan Mehta and starred Milind Soman.
plot:
By 2123, humans have conquered the Solar System and established space stations on several planets. The earth is governed by World Government, headquartered at Delhi.
As the series begins, Maya is traveling from Earth to Mars and during the journey is hit by a meteor and an unknown life-form is carried onto the spacecraft. After a successful landing on Mars she meets Astro Guru (Shrivallabh Vyas), oldest and wisest man in the world. He is also a scientist and astrologer and is trying to integrate physics and philosophy. After that Maya travels to Io, the moon of Jupiter, where she is to be the new jailer of the most secured prison in the solar system. It holds the 12 most dangerous criminals of the Universe in an incapacitated state, which are: 1. Teja / Tejang - The keeper of light (Aditya Sharma) 2. Mohini - The hypnotist (Malvika Singh) 3. Paras - The alchemist (Abhimanyu Singh) 4. Morpho - The shape-shifter (Andy Tharane) 5. Kineto - Master of telekinetic abilities (Ravi Khore) 6. Sonic - The Lord of soundwaves (Dino Morea) 7. Venom - The toxicologist (Madhu Sapre and Achint Kaur) 8. Chhalasur - The illusionist (Faredoon Dodo Bhujwala) 9. Durgati - The biologist (Sushmita Mukherjee) 10. Computo - The cyborg (Rukee Dadachanji) 11. Gravito - The gravity expert (Joy Fernandes) 12. Vikaal / Chronos - The space and time-traveler (Rahul Bose and Ken Philips). The unknown life-form enters the prison through Maya's boots and the criminals are awakened. They are aided by an ensuing meteor shower on Io. All 12 criminals escape the prison using their abilities to disable the security system on the prison.
Captain Vyom (Milind Soman), a super soldier, is assigned by World Government and Vishwapramukh - the world President (Tom Alter) to capture the fugitives. He is unaware of his parents and considers himself an orphan. He was raised in a monastery in Ladakh and has acquired superpowers by training in Yoga. He chooses a team of exceptionally-powered soldiers to fight the criminals. The team includes Pablo (Vinod Pandit) - the pilot, Lieutenant Maya (Kartika Rane) - expert in criminal psychology, Captain Blaze (Aarav Chowdhary) - the weapons expert, Dr. Zen (Divya Palat) - the medic, Fuller (Sanjeev Vatsa) - the engineer, Syd-E - the android (Shehzaad Saeed), and Surya (Jeto Sanjana). They travel through space in a spaceship named Ulka (उल्का - meaning meteor) developed by Fuller.
The series evolves as they come across the criminals one by one and capture them. Some of them were killed while others were captured and sent back to the prison. In the end, Captain Vyom has to travel back in time to pursue the 12th inmate Vikaal (Rahul Bose) who tries to kill Chandrakanth Shastri who would later become Astro Guru, to rewrite history. The story takes a turn while on mission to save Dr. Shastri from Vikaal, Vyom encounters his look alike Dr. Om Swaroop (Milind Soman). Refusing to go back to the present even after completing the mission, he sets out to find the whereabouts of his look alike person. Soon, Vyom finds out that Dr Swaroop is actually his biological father and seeks more knowledge about his mother.
It was revealed that the whole conspiracy of turning the brightest scientists of the galaxy into the evil side and then later plot to rescue them from the Io prison was orchestrated by Kaala Saaya - the Emperor of Parajeevs. Parajeevs are an advanced alien race of body parasites from seventh dimension. Their ultimate aim is to harvest a special fluid found only in human brains, that will help them to live thousands of years. He sends his daughter Parchhayee (Nethra Raghuraman) to earth in order to kill Dr. Om Swaroop as he was the only one with knowledge of advanced weaponry, G-gun to defeat the Parajeevs. But Parchayee gets cold feet as she start to fell in love with him and deviates from the mission given to her by her father. She helps Dr. Om from the assaults and later he was taken to other dimension where the Parajeevs would not reach. Capt. Vyom who is still in the past and having complete knowledge of using G-gun help defending the earth from the first war against the aliens successfully. This event results in uniting the World Nations and eventually makes way to the formation of world Government. Meanwhile, Parchayee who is in exile with Dr. Om, becomes mother of Vyom making him half-alien.
In present time, Kaala Saya, the emperor of Parajeevs (Aliens) sends his Parajeev agent to sabotage the spaceship Ulka. He was captured by Dr. Zen, and was imprisoned in a glass bowl. After completing his mission Vyom returns to present and interrogates the Parajeev, but he did not yield. After listening to the conversation between Capt. Vyom and Dr. Zen regarding the parentage of Vyom, the Parajeev offers to help them in reaching the Seventh Dimension where the Parajeevs live, and then to defeat them. He demands an audience with Astro Guru saying he will reveal the secrets of inter-dimensional travel, and ways to defeat the Parajeevs only to Astro Guru. After revealing the secrets to the virtual form of Astro Guru, the Parajeev commits suicide.
Astro Guru then entrusts Captain Vyom and his crew to embark on another mission to collect four essential objects that would help them to reach the seventh dimension and to defeat the Parajeevs. These 4 objects are:- a weapon to defeat the Parajeevs, a jewel that will act as a compass for the inter-dimensional travel, a herb that would enable humans to breathe in the seventh dimension, and a fuel that will enable Ulka for inter-dimensional travel. The crew splits into groups to collect those objects. Maya teams up with Capt. Blaze in search of the weapon, while Dr. Zen and Capt. Pablo was entrusted to bring the herb, Engineer Fuller and android Syd-E was sent to collect the fuel, while Capt. Vyom takes the responsibility of finding the jewel/ compass alone. Maya and Zen were stunned and kept as captive during their missions, while their partners returned to Ulka with the objects they sought. Engineer Fuller was consumed by a man-eating tree while collecting the fuel for the spaceship, while his partner Syd-E returns with the fuel.
Captain Vyom then sets out to defeat the Parajeevs. On his way, he was taken to another dimension where his father and mother lives. They give Vyom a crystal that will weaken the shield of Kaala Saaya. Eventually Captain Vyom confronts the emperor of Parajeevs - Kaala Saya, Vyom with the possession of the crystal weakens the emperor and is later revealed as the grandson of Kaalya Saaya. Kaala Saaya recognizes Vyom as the heir to the throne of seventh dimension, and finally convinces to take the responsibility as the new emperor. The series ends with Vyom the new emperor of Parajeevs, recollecting his past life adventures and hoping to meet his parents again in another dimension. Meanwhile, Maya and Dr. Zen agree to go on a date with Blaze and Pablo, respectively.

articleSections.title: Production
articleSections.text:
The futuristic science fiction show was conceived by Ketan Mehta. The special effects were created by Maya Entertainment Ltd. jointly owned by the National Film Development Corporation and Mehta. The series costed three times than the average production at that time due to special effects.
Model and actor Milind Soman was roped in to play the protagonist of the series.

articleSections.title: Release and reception
articleSections.text: The series aired in India on DD1 every Sunday 10 am in late 1998. The series received favorable response from audience and critics. It had considerable fan following in the 1990s. The series had rerun on SAB TV. In 2008, Soman expressed his willingness to star in the second season, film or video game if ever produced.

articleSections.title: Spin-off comics
articleSections.text: A comics based on the television series was published by Diamond Comics in English and several other Indian languages. The comics maintained the storyline of the original television series.

articleSections.title: Future
articleSections.text: In June 2022, it was announced that Brewing Thoughts Pvt Ltd has acquired the remake rights of Captain Vyom from Maya Entertainment Ltd and they have announced that they will make 5 films and a 5 season show based on the 1998 TV show.

episodesList.title: Episode 1
episodesList.summary: As the future of year 2123 AD is shown, it's revealed that Delhi is capital of World government. Dr Ray from Earth's station is in command to send Lieutenant Maya to Mars station. Maya travels to Mars avoiding meteors attacking Maya's spaceship. Upon reaching Mars station, Maya meets Commander Zoltan, in charge of a jail located on Io, one of the moons of planet Jupiter. It's here on Mars that Maya meets Surya, son of Commander Zoltan. The first person Zoltan takes Maya to meet is Astroguru, claimed as oldest and wisest man in Universe. Astroguru is dazzled by Maya's beauty. He later seems to know about Maya's sister and her medical condition and also predicts she will go on a dangerous mission with few people, that will change her life forever. Later Zoltan takes Maya to jail, located on Io, housing 12 of the most dangerous creatures of the galaxy. Zoltan explains how the Io jail is the most secured jail of the galaxy with five layers of security: volcano tunnel, diamond gate, time warp, laser web and astro-shield energy vacuum. All 12 creatures captured are then introduced and Zoltan explains to Maya their abilities and powers along with their history. As the episode ends, some unpredictable behavior of a meteor cluster is revealed, which is about to fall on Io moon.

Venom - The toxicologist (Madhu Sapre and Achint Kaur) 8. Chhalasur - The illusionist (Faredoon Dodo Bhujwala) 9. Durgati - The biologist (Sushmita Mukherjee) 10. Computo - The cyborg (Rukee Dadachanji) 11. Gravito - The gravity expert (Joy Fernandes) 12. Vikaal / Chronos - The space and time-traveler (Rahul Bose and Ken Philips). The unknown life-form enters the prison through Maya's boots and the criminals are awakened. They are aided by an ensuing meteor shower on Io. All 12 criminals escape the prison using their abilities to disable the security system on the prison. Captain Vyom (Milind Soman), a super soldier, is assigned by World Government and Vishwapramukh - the world President (Tom Alter) to capture the fugitives. He is unaware of his parents and considers himself an orphan. He was raised in a monastery in Ladakh and has acquired superpowers by training in Yoga. He chooses a team of exceptionally-powered soldiers to fight the criminals. The team includes Pablo (Vinod Pandit) - the pilot, Lieutenant Maya (Kartika Rane) - expert in criminal psychology, Captain Blaze (Aarav Chowdhary) - the weapons expert, Dr. Zen (Divya Palat) - the medic, Fuller (Sanjeev Vatsa) - the engineer, Syd-E - the android (Shehzaad Saeed), and Surya (Jeto Sanjana). They travel through space in a spaceship named Ulka (उल्का - meaning meteor) developed by Fuller. The series evolves as they come across the criminals one by one and capture them. Some of them were killed while others were captured and sent back to the prison. In the end, Captain Vyom has to travel back in time to pursue the 12th inmate Vikaal (Rahul Bose) who tries to kill Chandrakanth Shastri who would later become Astro Guru, to rewrite history. The story takes a turn while on mission to save Dr. Shastri from Vikaal, Vyom encounters his look alike Dr. Om Swaroop (Milind Soman). Refusing to go back to the present even after completing the mission, he sets out to find the whereabouts of his look alike person. Soon, Vyom finds out that Dr Swaroop is actually his biological father and seeks more knowledge about his mother. It was revealed that the whole conspiracy of turning the brightest scientists of the galaxy into the evil side and then later plot to rescue them from the Io prison was orchestrated by Kaala Saaya - the Emperor of Parajeevs. Parajeevs are an advanced alien race of body parasites from seventh dimension. Their ultimate aim is to harvest a special fluid found only in human brains, that will help them to live thousands of years. He sends his daughter Parchhayee (Nethra Raghuraman) to earth in order to kill Dr. Om Swaroop as he was the only one with knowledge of advanced weaponry, G-gun to defeat the Parajeevs. But Parchayee gets cold feet as she start to fell in love with him and deviates from the mission given to her by her father. She helps Dr. Om from the assaults and later he was taken to other dimension where the Parajeevs would not reach. Capt. Vyom who is still in the past and having complete knowledge of using G-gun help defending the earth from the first war against the aliens successfully. This event results in uniting the World Nations and eventually makes way to the formation of world Government. Meanwhile, Parchayee who is in exile with Dr. Om, becomes mother of Vyom making him half-alien. In present time, Kaala Saya, the emperor of Parajeevs (Aliens) sends his Parajeev agent to sabotage the spaceship Ulka. He was captured by Dr. Zen, and was imprisoned in a glass bowl. After completing his mission Vyom returns to present and interrogates the Parajeev, but he did not yield. After listening to the conversation between Capt. Vyom and Dr. Zen regarding the parentage of Vyom, the Parajeev offers to help them in reaching the Seventh Dimension where the Parajeevs live, and then to defeat them. He demands an audience with Astro Guru saying he will reveal the secrets of inter-dimensional travel, and ways to defeat the Parajeevs only to Astro Guru. After revealing the secrets to the virtual form of Astro Guru, the Parajeev commits suicide. Astro Guru then entrusts Captain Vyom and his crew to embark on another mission to collect four essential objects that would help them to reach the seventh dimension and to defeat the Parajeevs. These 4 objects are:- a weapon to defeat the Parajeevs, a jewel that will act as a compass for the inter-dimensional travel, a herb that would enable humans to breathe in the seventh dimension, and a fuel that will enable Ulka for inter-dimensional travel. The crew splits into groups to collect those objects. Maya teams up with Capt. Blaze in search of the weapon, while Dr. Zen and Capt. Pablo was entrusted to bring the herb, Engineer Fuller and android Syd-E was sent to collect the fuel, while Capt. Vyom takes the responsibility of finding the jewel/ compass alone. Maya and Zen were stunned and kept as captive during their missions, while their partners returned to Ulka with the objects they sought. Engineer Fuller was consumed by a man-eating tree while collecting the fuel for the spaceship, while his partner Syd-E returns with the fuel. Captain Vyom then sets out to defeat the Parajeevs. On his way, he was taken to another dimension where his father and mother lives. They give Vyom a crystal that will weaken the shield of Kaala Saaya. Eventually Captain Vyom confronts the emperor of Parajeevs - Kaala Saya, Vyom with the possession of the crystal weakens the emperor and is later revealed as the grandson of Kaalya Saaya. Kaala Saaya recognizes Vyom as the heir to the throne of seventh dimension, and finally convinces to take the responsibility as the new emperor. The series ends with Vyom the new emperor of Parajeevs, recollecting his past life adventures and hoping to meet his parents again in another dimension. Meanwhile, Maya and Dr. Zen agree to go on a date with Blaze and Pablo, respectively.

title: Chandrakanta
summary: Chandrakanta is an Indian fantasy television series partly based on Devaki Nandan Khatri's 1888 novel of the same name. It was originally telecast on DD National between 1994 and 1996 and was created, written, produced, and directed by Nirja Guleri. The serial was pulled off air by Doordarshan in 1996 and the producers had to file a suit in court for reinstatement. Reruns of the show also aired on StarPlus, Sony Entertainment Television.

articleSections.title: Criticism
articleSections.text: Kamlapati Khatri, the grandson of the novel's author, has said that the producer "had not done justice to the soul of Khatri's Chandrakanta". He has also accused the producers of willfully misrepresenting certain concepts from the novel, such as "tilism" (kind of a maze) and "ayyari" (spying), and showing them as "jadu-tona" (sorcery), as well as criticizing the characters and the sequences in the Chunar fort for being overly exaggerated, and how far into the show Chandrakanta appeared.

title: Cinemala
summary: Cinemala (transl. Cinema Chain) is an Indian Malayalam language satirical comedy Television Series in Asianet TV channel. Starting Dileep and Salim Kumar in leading roles.

articleSections.title: Broadcast
articleSections.text: The first episode aired on Asianet, a Malayalam news television network, on 20 August 1993. It was the first show aired on Asianet. The program was broadcast in thirty-minute episodes every Sunday at 1:30 pm (IST) until it stopped airing in 2013.

articleSections.title: History
articleSections.text:
It started as a film-based satire, which later on began to delve into contemporary political and social issues. It focused on current events, often referencing figures such as politicians and media personalities in a satirical way. These public figures were played by mimicry artists from Malayalam television.
It was awarded a place in the Limca Book of Records as one of the longest-running TV shows.

articleSections.title: Cinemala 1000
articleSections.text: To celebrate the broadcasting of the 1,000th episode of Cinemala, Asianet conducted a mega stage show on July 31, 2013 titled CINEMA LA 1000 at Gokulam Convention Centre, Kochi, Kerala. Leading actors Dileep and Salim Kumar were honored during the occasion. Mementos were presented to all actors who had been a part of the Cinemala. The show featured comedy skits by Cinemala actors as well as performances by other actors such as Suraj Venjaramoodu, Mamukkoya, Indrans, P. Jayachandran, Usha Uthup, Sithara, Shamna Kasim, Subi and Tesni Khan.

title: Chanakya
summary: Chanakya is a 47-part drama epic Indian television historical drama written and directed by Dr. Chandraprakash Dwivedi that was originally telecasted on DD National from 8 September 1991 to 9 August 1992. Produced by Prakash Dwivedi, the series is a fictionalized account of the life and times of 4th century BCE Indian economist, strategist and political theorist Chanakya (also known as Vishnugupta) and is based on events occurring between 340 BCE and 321/20 BCE, starting with Chanakya's boyhood and culminating in the coronation of Chandragupta Maurya. Chandraprakash Dwivedi played the title role of Chanakya.
plot:
The series is divided into three acts :-
* The early life of Vishnugupta in the kingdom of Magadha and the circumstances leading to his self-imposed exile, particularly the persecution (and subsequent death) of his father at the hands of Dhana Nanda, King of Magadha. * The invasion of northwestern India by Alexander, his death, the rebellion led by native Indian kingdoms under the leadership of Chandragupta Maurya against Alexander's successors in India, and the subsequent defeat of the Greek invaders. * The attack on and overthrow of the Nanda rule in Magadha and the crowning of Chandragupta as the King of Magadha.
Within this framework, Dwivedi portrays the politics that governed relations between kings and officials of that time. He cleverly covers the workings of the early Indian republics and the way of life of ordinary Indians.
While critically acclaimed, Chanakya has been the subject of political controversy too. It has been televised in many countries around the world and has won five Uptron Awards.
reception:
The series gathered much praise for its authenticity, particularly the way it used costumes and similar artistic devices.
The series was commercially successful for Doordarshan, bringing in INR 180 million in advertising revenues. While thinking about opening up the organization's second channel, DD Metro, to private producers in lieu of license fees, it took the Chanakya experience into consideration with a Doordarshan official commenting that "quality programmes can attract enough advertising support to sustain even small producers who could be bidding for time slots on the metro channel."
Chanakya brought instant and lasting recognition to the director and chief protagonist, Dwivedi,

articleSections.title: Development
articleSections.text: Dwivedi spent more than nine years researching Chanakya and read over 180 books on the subject including the Arthashastra. Dwivedi didn't conceive of the series as a "purely factual account" of Chanakya's life and times. But he did want "to present a work of fiction based on historical evidence—unlike the serials Ramayan and Mahabharat which presented history with a touch of masala." He didn't want to "[create] false drama just to appease popular sentiments." Dwivedi submitted his script to Doordarshan in April 1986 and shot the plot after receiving the approval sometime in 1988. He submitted it to the channel in December 1988 and got the final approval by the end of the year. BR Chopra, the producer of Mahabharat had been interested in the series and had submitted a proposal of his own to Doordarshan. However, Doordarshan preferred Dwivedi's project to Chopra's proposal which had been "found wanting."

articleSections.title: Filming
articleSections.text:
The pilot was shot at a cost of INR 1.8 million (15 million in 2009, as estimated by Dwivedi). Doordarshan initially allotted 26 episodes for the series and an extension was promised if "the quality was up to the mark." The first 17 episodes were shot over nine months at an estimated average cost of INR 900,000 per episode. A huge cast of about 300 actors were involved with the production. Arif was also part of the cast, as narrator and as the character Sidhartak. Roy remained art director for the first 25 episodes, and Nitin Chandrakant Desai, who was assisting him, took over Episode 26 onwards.
"Magnificent sets" were created at Film City, Bombay (now Mumbai) for the series and an amount of INR 7 million was budgeted to build three cities including Pataliputra and Takshashila. The result was a town with "26 structures, four main lanes and six bylanes," all part of a single set.
Close attention was paid to detail when it came to costumes and weaponry, so much so that a piece of armor worn by Chandragupta was procured for over INR 8,000. Terracotta sculptures from the 1st century CE, the museums at Sarnath, Patna and Lucknow, and the caves at the Borivali National Park were other sources of inspiration. In a 2009 interview, Salim Arif considered his work on Chanakya to be better than that on Bharat Ek Khoj.

articleSections.title: Casting
articleSections.text: Dwivedi chose stage actors to play the parts in the series. Pramod Moutho, Suraj Chaddha, Ragini Shah, Ajay Dubey, Arun Bali, Vipin Sharma and Himanshu Gokani were among the first to be selected.
